Bondi's young guns race out for a number of mass rescues. And to fully initiate the new trainee in to the team, the veterans play a prank on Harrison - when they task him with counting the number of people on the beach.

One of the most dramatic Bondi rescue episodes ever. When lifeguards attend a man complaining of chest pains, he suddenly has a cardiac arrest in front of them. They perform CPR desperately trying to resuscitate him. Later a beach goer suffers an agonising dislocated knee.

A woman is found lifeless between the flags, she's not breathing and doesn't have a pulse. As lifeguards begin chest compressions to try bring her back to life, the woman's mentally impaired son arrives looking for mum. A very special episode of Bondi Rescue, not to be missed.

The surf club rescue boat has a spectacular 'upside-down' collision with a reef. Even morphine can't stop a young boy's painful howls when he suffers a mystery stomach illness.

Harries attempts to play matchmaker for Singlets. Harries, Max, and Singlets conduct a mass rescue, saving seven people caught in two separate rips. Harrison and Harries encounter a phone thief. A missing dad is reported on the beach.

A man is dragged unconscious from the water, no pulse and not breathing. Reidy and Beardy attach the defibrillator and oxygen mask and begin resuscitation. This is what they train for, but there's always the risk it may not go as planned. An emotional life and death Bondi Rescue, not to be missed.

Riding on the jet ski, Reidy spots a shark off Bondi. As more shark sightings are reported by beachgoers, lifeguards sound the alarm. Later Jake must retrieve a dead body, it's an emotional job in a tough season for the young lifeguard.

A simple miscommunication during a serious rescue could cost two people their lives. Mouse and Chappo help a family to find their lost Grandma. Jess administers adrenaline to a young woman who is suffering an allergic reaction.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

Bra Boy Jesse rescues a vicious rat from the skate bowl, lifeguards play detectives after a punch-up in the surf break, and Harries swims more than a kilometre out to sea. None of this is in the lifeguard manual, but the boys tackle it with lifeguard ingenuity and a healthy dose of humour.

Lifeguards anticipate some well-deserved rest as Bondi's summer winds down, but a sudden monster swell brings unexpected challenges. Corey grapples with rescuing swimmers in massive waves. Trainees Ryan and Glick aim to impress in the upcoming lifeguard challenge.

Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

When Daeje, suffering from severe headaches and unable to even stand, is rushed into the ER, tension grips the hospital. Unaware that Jaein is Daeje's granddaughter, Minwoo stays by her side, watching over a visibly shaken and distraught Jaein.

The hospital staff soon learns the shocking truth—that Jaein is the chairman's granddaughter. At the same time, an emergency audit is launched by the Ministry of Health and Welfare. With Daeje still unconscious, calls rise to convene a board meeting to determine who will lead the hospital in his absence, leaving Geumnyeo deep in deliberation.

When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

Leaving her audience with Inbin, Jeongi runs into Gangcheon and Yukdo at the palace. When King Seonjo refers to Euldam as a traitor, Jeongi is left on edge. Together with Taedo, she devises a plan to ensnare Gangcheon. Later, Gwanghae returns the bowl Jeongi once gave to Son Haengsu. Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

Freddy (Shemar Moore) is a big-shot music industry executive, whose cousin, Blusette (Salli Richardson), is a successful and well-known singer managed by 8-Ball Harris (Ernie Hudson). Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him.

Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programmes.st: Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon, Day 3
programmes.d: Catherine Southon decides to change her buying strategy, going for more of Philip Serrell's rust-and-woodworm fare. Phil diverts to the beach and asks a local fisherman if he has some antique chandlery to sell!

programmes.st: Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon, Day 4
programmes.d: Catherine Southon heads to Porthcurno to see the incredible cables that stretch from this little village to South America, Australia, and India. Phil Serrell goes for a ride on a replica of the Puffing Devil.

programmes.st: Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon, Day 5
programmes.d: Catherine Southon heads to the Royal Mint and finds out how Sir Isaac Newton revolutionized coins to prevent forgers. Phil Serrell gets a lesson in the culture at the Bristol Old Vic and discovers why it's a miracle the building still stands.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle, Day 1
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle are in Northumberland. Paul discovers the Morpeth Olympics and Claire learns about the female Indiana Jones, Gertrude Bell. Everything's rosy until Claire mentions she loves militaria -- Paul's specialty!

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle, Day 2
programmes.d: Claire Rawle finds out about the Tynemouth Volunteer Life Brigade and Paul Laidlaw visits a military observation post in Blyth. And Paul finds some RAF stereoscopic aerial reconnaissance photographs of German U-boats at a great price.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle, Day 3
programmes.d: Claire Rawle discovers the history of big game fishing in the 1930s, while Paul Laidlaw sets off to rendezvous in a secret WWII bunker. Paul buys a pair of Charles Barlow vases, and Claire picks up an early 20th-century spectacle case.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle, Day 4
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw finds a rare 18th-century puzzle jug, and Claire Rawle some Shelley porcelain. Paul discovers how Hull was vital to thousands of Jews fleeing from Tsarist Russia and Claire indulges her passion for all things railway.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Claire Rawle, Day 5
programmes.d: In the final, Paul Laidlaw hopes a late 17th-century hand-forged halberd head will earn him a huge profit. Claire Rawle buys a Chinese cloisonné vase and an Edwardian inkstand. Will Claire be the comeback kid and crush the mighty Laidlaw?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 1
programmes.d: It's a Welsh road trip for Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw. Some fake currency and a leg of mutton could cause problems for our pair of antiquers at a Somerset auction.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 2
programmes.d: Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw forage for antiques across the West Country in a stylish 1960s Volvo. Paul's fortunes rest on a treasure from Africa while Kate blows a very, very big horn.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 3
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw resorts to tank warfare to crush Kate Bliss's chances of profit. Kate finds out about a decisive naval confrontation while Paul heads to Southampton to discover how Britain's landscape has been mapped for generations.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 4
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss hope to capitalize on some risky buys. Paul believes a strange collection of medals will honor him with profits, but will a pricey three-figure gamble purchase pay off for Kate?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 5
programmes.d: Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw's final trip sees them through Kent. At an incredible auction in Bury St. Edmunds, the Antiques Road Trip record profit is truly smashed, and when the gavel finally goes down one expert is left close to tears.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 1
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton are in the Scottish Borders with a '60s Jaguar. James resorts to a flashlight as he rummages in the dark for an occasional table while Christina hopes some silver-plated cutlery will serve up a profit.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 2
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's are in the cold and snowy Trossachs. James investigates some ancient treasures in a Glasgow graveyard and farmer's wife Christina learns why it was the Scots who transformed arable farming.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 3
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton start in Levenshulme, Manchester. James has the unusual problem of having too much cash, while Christina struggles with her limited funds, deciding to gamble them on a worn toy train.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 4
programmes.d: The seaside town of Southport in Merseyside is Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's next stop. Christina dibs her way to a purchase with a Scouting connection and James spends a vast amount of his cash on two Cantonese jardinières.

Derek and Ashley reach a breaking point, Dani finally defines the line between sex and something more, Doug scrambles to cover his lies before they destroy everything, and Leslie proves she's not going down without a fight.
Anita opens the door to her past, Ashley's heartbreak threatens to undo her, and Eva leans into the one person who believes her.

The Duprees navigate heartbreak and hard truths as Eva makes a fateful choice about her mother, Ashley and Derek confront what's left of their love, and Chelsea opens up about who she is - even if it hurts.
Eva pushes back against her mother's delusions, Anita and Tracy unpack old wounds, and Nicole, Ted, and Kat confront a chilling possibility: what if Leslie's lies are just the beginning?

Anita and Tracy finally confront the betrayal that tore them apart, Ted corners Leslie with a devastating accusation, Doug begins to connect the dots about Joey's friendship with his wife, and Martin's lack of communication frustrates Smitty.
Martin dodges Smitty's questions about Bill's insinuations, Hayley's unexpected news throws Chelsea for a loop, and Kat lets her guard down with Tomas.

Smitty grows increasingly suspicious, Chelsea's news has Dani doubting reality. Ashley and Derek confront the lingering tension in their relationship, and Tyrell's insecurities sabotage his moment with Jessica.
Dani issues a warning to Bill regarding Hayley, Doug takes a risk with Joey, and Kat and Jacob uncover more about Laura's attack. Meanwhile, Leslie tries to pull Ted back into her world.
A crucial piece of evidence comes to light in Kat's investigation of Leslie, Ted struggles with how to repair his relationship with Nicole, and Anita fears the past will derail her future.
Ted and Eva discuss Leslie's manipulations and Sharon confronts Anita with the painful truth of their past.
Leslie turns to an unlikely source for help; Naomi and Hayley find themselves in a life-changing situation; and Dani struggles with her insecurities about Andre.
Jacob catches a break in Leslie's case; Doug has unexpected news for Bill; and Chelsea makes a mysterious connection
Kat receives unexpected news; Laura turns to an unlikely source for help, and Sharon's bitterness threatens to derail the reunion with Anita. Meanwhile, Ted coaxes a confession out of Eva.
Unaware of hidden dangers, Eva and Tomas share an intimate moment; Vanessa confronts Doug about his gambling debts, and Chelsea opens up to Naomi about her feelings for someone special.
Everyone returns to the Rainsworth manor after their tussle with the Citizens of Baskerville, but Oz, Gilbert and Alice are still sad about what happened at the Lutwidge Academy.
Oz and his group decide to visit Rufus Barma, the longest-living man among the Four Great Dukes and a strange, rotund being in a suit.
More of the truth is divulged through Break and Barma, like Breaks past, the connection between Alice and the Abyss and Vincent, as well.
Oz keeps searching for pieces of Alice's memories, but is unsuccessful and Gilbert continues to look for the truth about what happened one hundred years ago.
A change in the Will of the Abyss causes a huge amount of Chains to appear in Reveille and members of Pandora are sent to end the invasion, but their success is limited.
Oscar visits Oz and tells him to come home because his father has been missing for over 10 years.
Daikichi suggests Rin plant a memorial tree; Daikichi seeks out Masako for answers.
Daikichi marvels at how strong his cousin Haruko became after raising her daughter, Reina, alone.
Rin is on summer vacation; Daikichi and Rin visit Souichi's grave and discover Masako has visited.
Daikichi brings Rin and her friend Kouki home, where they await an enormous typhoon.
When Rin develops a fever after a festival, Daikichi discovers just how important she is to him.
Daikichi reflects on his first year with Rin and the wonderful things she brings to his life.

Team Barefoot is pitted against Team Magical Illusion.
Satellites parts are seriously damaged after being deliberately taken down.
Cat suddenly arrives with a brand-new footballer to help Team Barefoot.
Team Barefoot gets into the semi-finals.
Myth easily scores twice against Team Sky-wheels.
A middle-aged office worker and a high school student are both struck by a UFO and rebuilt as powerful human-robot hybrids, but what they do with that power could not be more different.

Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others; Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot; Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his friend and his family and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately.

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away; Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his friend Naoyuki Ando.
When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps her, drugs her up, and then roughs her up; Samejima sets his sights on Fumino, and has his men kidnap her.

Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions; after reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami.

Shishigami escapes from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree; Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him; Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities.
Fuyutsuki receives some beauty tips from a most unlikely source.
A bully and the student she has been tormenting are assigned to be roommates during a class field trip.
Two students get lost on the way to locate an island treasure.
Who will survive this epic competition and rise to power, and which Houseguest will end up on the block?
The Power of Veto is on the line, will Jag or Blue secure their safety? Plus, will Jared spill his big secret?

Either Jag or Blue will be evicted, or will they?  Because one of the four Houseguests you chose to compete for the BB Power of Invincibility will win the chance to save an evicted Houseguest.  Who will play?  Who will win?  And will they stop
Every houseguest competes for the most important Head of Household so far. Who will win power, and who will they target?
Will the Power of Veto save one of the Chillers from the hot seat, and if so who will become Jared's next target?
Will eviction history repeat itself for Jag, or will the chillbillie be left out in the cold? Plus, who will become the next Head of Household?
Humila Week is under way and the space cowboy is in control. Will Cameron cause chaos and shake up the house?
The Power of Veto is on the line, with special guest host Josh Duhamel. Will the golden power save one of the nominees, and will Cameron shock the house by backdooring Cirie?

One of Cirie's top allies exits the game, but will it be who she expects?  Plus, the Head of Household is on the line in the iconic Wall Competition and the Houseguests come face-to-face with a legendary meatball.
Who will conquer the wall and become the new Head of Household, and which houseguest will be targeted for eviction?  Plus witness the war of words that blew the house apart before Izzys departure.
Who will win the Power of Veto, and will the plan to get Cameron on the block succeed?

Will Cameron finally be evicted from the House?  Who will follow?  A terrifying Double Eviction kicks off Scary Week, a full week of gameplay and one night of fright.  Plus, a scary ending that will send shivers down the spines of all who survive.
Jared and Cameron return from the grave as BB zombies, how will the house react to this spine-tingling twist? Plus witness all the crazy drama you didn't see during the death-defying double.
Which zombie will emerge from the Resurrection Rumble, with the power to put fate in his own hands?  And who will have their game dead and buried for good?
The game resumes with the final ten vying for the Head of Household. Who will win the power, and which two guests will be put on the chopping block?
Will Felicia or Mecole's soul be saved at the Veto Competition?  And will Cameron's target change to a bombshell backdoor?
Nick and Suzanne's next door's neighbors become irresponsible house sitters.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Suzanne gathers everyone up for a family portrait.

programmes.st: The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode
programmes.d: Nick host a fund-raiser for charity. Elsewhere, Suzanne tangles with a wealthy client.

programmes.st: The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode
programmes.d: Nick is coerced into hiring an assistant, but the newbie gets too close to Nick's family and friends.
Nick and Suzanne get into an argument and refuse to talk to each other.
Lindsey and Kevin give to a charity, but Nick must step in when the charity keeps asking for more and more money.
Nick and Suzanne plan to attend a high-profile movie premiere, but their busy schedules create complications.
Nick retaliates after he overhears Suzanne telling personal information to Gigi.
The spread of certain secrets could ruin two newfound romances.
Nick and Suzanne consider purchasing life insurance.
Nick discovers he has high-blood pressure and looks for ways to diminish stress in his life.
Nick hopes to hire a golden-voiced man for voice-over work; Suzanne misplaces Gigi's expensive cashmere sweater.
Nick helps out a coworker by ghostwriting him love letters for a woman on a dating website who turns out to be Gigi.
Nick's identity is usurped by another man named Nick Kingston-Persons.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
Marilyn dates a younger man, but Nick has suspicions about her new beau's true motives. Meanwhile, Kevin breaks his arm.
Friends and extended family gather for a Thanksgiving dinner, but Suzanne forgets the turkey.
Nick is voted as Seattle's sexiest sportscaster, but his newfound celebrity has downsides.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his \\"proposa-versary\\" with Suzanne, who is none too pleased.
Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam.
Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.
Drew tries to keep her date away from Marianna, believing she might steal him from her.
Danny decides to spend time with people his own age since he spends too much time with his mother.
Danny and Sam become mentors for two troubled kids. Floyd is robbed just outside the diner.
After being accused of infidelity, Danny fears for his safety.
Family and friends gather at Hattie's during a storm.
Hattie and Drew make Linda an online dating profile.
Linda meets a man she met online.
There's bad news about Linda's new boyfriend.
Will ends up not being as bad as everyone thought.
Lily reaches out to Ryan after leaving Loyal Ink, Charmaine's mom encourages her to rebuild a friendship, and Phor misses a crucial deadline with London on da Track.
Nikki confronts Phor about sending sexts to another woman, Charmaine thinks she might be pregnant, and things come full circle when Ryan makes a play to take over Loyal Ink.
Weeks after Ryan's dramatic takeover of 9MAG, tensions run high between Phor and Don, Ryan and Rachel reach the end of the road, and Charmaine undergoes a medical procedure.
Lily becomes a reluctant co-parent when Bella moves in, Charmaine gabs about Phor's sexts on the radio, and Van finally forgives Ryan for past betrayals.
Lily flirts with the shop's new guest artist, Don is forced to kick a resentful Brittany out of the shop, and Van's new apprentice rubs the ladies of 9MAG the wrong way.

Charmaine takes the 9MAG crew to Vegas for a tattoo convention in an attempt to prove her worth to Ryan. When Van's apprentice shows up, everyone speculates on where she's going to be sleeping at night. Meanwhile, Don focuses on his family back home.

programmes.st: The Story of the Spyder and the Fish
programmes.d: Tensions between Donna and the team come to a head when the Black Ink Bosses decide to bring the teams together for some team bonding in the woods.

programmes.st: It's Better When a Woman is in Charge
programmes.d: Tired of the constant fighting over who the best tattoo artist is, Ceaser decides to have the Black Ink artists put their art where their mouth is by conducting the first Black Ink tattoo competition to crown the lead artist.
Alex struggles with quarantining and his relationship with Donna, Tatti heads to Long Island to check on her family, and Krystal performs at Ted's showcase.
As the crew gets ready to return to New York, Ceaser plans a final party in Atlanta and stuns Suzette when he gets down on one knee. Walt goes to extreme lengths to prove his innocence.
In the season premiere, the crew celebrates 10 years of Black Ink. The first ever Black Ink graduation ceremony goes left when Ceaser realizes that not everyone deserves to be head of the class.
After Ceaser's talk with Ted and Puma, it's time for him to take on the other problem child. While Puma continues to handle things at home, Quani tries to find her independence and herself.
Spyder worries that his first pop-up shop will be a flop as Tatti looks to Krystal and Bae for advice on a special assignment. The Black Ink Bosses finally reunite after their heated confrontation.

Ceaser makes a public announcement about changes at the shop that could have a chilling effect on Rok and Krystal. Tatti gets a cold lesson in humility from Bae while deciding to take some personal matters into her own hands.

programmes.st: Guess Who's Coming To Black Ink?
programmes.d: Change is in the air at Black Ink as Ceaser introduces some new blood to the crew. Rok and Krystal consider their future at Black Ink as Bux opens up to bring awareness to others with his lifelong battle.

programmes.st: Black Ink & Harlem Are Like PB&J
programmes.d: Ceaser is forced to make a hard decision about 125th. Bux gets an unexpected visit at the shop that rocks his world and his friendship. Alex holds auditions for his OnlyFans and is blown away by their talents.

programmes.st: So Much For A Mental Health Day
programmes.d: Chaos ensues when the 125th artists merge with the Brooklyn shop. A startling revelation about Rok causes Ted and Puma to panic. Bux makes the situation with Spyder worse. Ceaser announces an out-of-town trip and Tatti goes MIA.

When a member of the Reagan clan is shot, Danny tries to track down the gang member responsible, without letting his emotions get the best of him.
Frank goes on high alert when a threat to New York City may be imminent following a terrorist attack in the Middle East, on the sixth season premiere of BLUE BLOODS.
Danny and Baez investigate a possible serial killer who sends a chilling message to Danny, and Erin toys with the idea of applying for a judgeship.

programmes.st: All the News That’s Fit To Click
programmes.d: When newspaper reporter Lorenzo Colt (Zachary Booth) is targeted while wearing NYPD gear on a ride-along with Jamie and Eddie, Frank puts Danny and Baez on the hunt for the shooter who may be out for other members on the force.
Erin’s attempt to convict a slippery mob boss for an old murder is muddled when her former informant, Vincent (Dan Hedaya), leaves witness protection to provide his old boss with an alibi.

Danny joins the hunt for two escaped convicts after hearing one of them is someone he helped to wrongfully imprison. Also, Gormley criticizes a plan from Trey Delgado (Esai Morales), an NYPD sergeant who Gormley thinks is having an affair with his wife.
When Jamie is caught on camera committing what could be construed as police brutality at an anti-policy demonstration, Frank is forced to turn the case over to Internal Affairs.
Danny and Baez investigate the theft of the famous car that was driven in a classic film, now owned by Owen Cairo (Anthony Edwards).

When Danny and his family are threatened by Thomas Wilder (Louis Cancelmi), a serial killer Danny has been unable to apprehend, Linda’s concern intensifies over her husband’s job as well as the state of their marriage.

When a homicide case ends in a hung jury, Erin is forced to take over the case from her colleague, ADA Kelly Blake (Diane Neal), and with the help of DA investigator Anthony Abetemarco (Steve Schirripa), find a missing witness.
Danny is interrogated by the District Attorney’s investigator when his ex-partner is accused of planting evidence in order to wrap up a homicide case.
When a local mobster is gunned down in his car, Danny and Baez try to get information from the mob’s low-level errand boy they find tied up in the trunk before the gang retaliates.
When Frank’s first partner announces plans to publish a book filled with stories of their early days on the force, Frank worries about his personal stories being made public.
When a well-regarded, newly retired NYPD lieutenant is accused of shooting a group of potential muggers on the subway and then disappears, Frank must deal with the fallout.
Danny must determine who murdered a man when multiple women who worked for him all take credit for it.
Erin is overwhelmed with guilt after a man she set free is accused of killing a cop.
Linda asks Danny and Baez to help her co-worker who is having trouble with her angry ex-husband.
While Sheriff Coffee is in Saint Louis, the Morrisey bunch decides to work off excess energy by wrecking the saloon in a violent spree.

Dolly Bantree has a crooked manager ""Blackie"",  who blackmails Dolly to fleece newly rich miner Buford out of his newfound wealth. Hoss suspects something and gets all duded up to pose as a rich mark to test Dolly.
While hunting for a wolf, Joe is attacked by the wolf.  Adam also hunting for the wolf, hears Joe struggling with the wolf comes to Joe's aid.
Hoss volunteers to pickup an injured neighbor's mail-order bride, but by the time they return, she has fallen in love with Hoss and a price is put on Hoss' head.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away.  Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.
Not one, but three mail-order brides show up unexpectedly at the Ponderosa, all of them believing they are to marry Hoss.
After inadvertantly falling into the river, Adam is rescued by Tom Wilson.  Wilson has feelings for Sue Miller, which bring him into trouble after her father is killed.
When Hoss is responsible for causing a hung jury, Ben tells him, "a man is never wrong doing what he thinks is right", and Adam attempts to validate his brother's reasonable doubt.
Everyone feels Andy Walker is an outstanding singer but his father, who feels the boy should concentrate on ranch work instead.  Joe mentions receiving a letter from Adam, currently in Paris.
Hoss and a pair of nuns, the younger one having a difficult time training for the order, are robbed and stranded at a way station.
Adam, Hoss, and Joe vie for the attention of a pretty young lady named Dolores.  Hoss talks Joe into entering a bull fight, but it doesn't work out quite as planned.
Adam encounters drunken artist James Callan, branded a "squaw man" because he is married to an Indian, and whose talent is going to waste in the town of Sheep Head.
Ben and Claire Armory fall in love, but their future is jeopardized by her disabled brother.
Moody bounty hunter, Dev Farnum, shows up on the Ponderosa, where the Cartwrights are harboring the wife of the man he is after.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.
Joe is goaded into facing gunman Dan Taggert, unaware there is more to be prearranged than he realizes.
Tsubaki devises a plan to hone her team’s skills, where they fight for who performs best on missions.
Himawari attends the Ninja Academy's trial session where participants get a taste of ninja training.
Team 7 is assigned to back up the Leaf Police Force on a security mission. Their client is a president of a company who is being targeted by a serial killer known as \"The Rainy Day Killer.\"

programmes.st: I Can't Stay in My Slim Form
programmes.d: After hearing thieves have been raiding deliveries of azuki beans, Cho-Cho plans to team up with Anko Mitarashi to capture the bandits!
Sai and Sasuke journey to the Hidden Rain Village to find a location thought to be the hideout of an organization known as Kara, the Husk.
Boruto and Team 7 are tasked with a mission to find a missing researcher of a medical equipment company in a distant nation
Boruto and the team finally find the missing researcher. Despite his resistance, the team is determined to take him back safely to their client.
Leaving Mitsuki in the care of Yubina, a doctor and friend of Mugino, Boruto and the others go to a black market in the Land of Silence.
Boruto and the others learn that the Hashirama Cell is in the hands of a wealthy individual who lives in Fushuu Castle, and plan on retrieving it.
Boruto and the others are involved in an incident at Fushuu Castle, and on top of being branded criminals, they are being pursued by a gang from the Land of Silence.
Team 7 and Mugino manage to evade the gang and continue their pursuit of the culprits.
Boruto and the team finally catch up to the real thieves.
Boruto and the others manage to escape Yuuga's barrier, but this time his younger brother Hiruga gets in their way.
Boruto and the team are determined to reach Asaka, the eldest brother of the Land of Silence Ninja, before Deepa does.
Boruto and Sarada convalesce at the Leaf Hospital while Mitsuki returns to Orochimaru's for treatment.
Boruto and Sarada begin intensive training after experiencing defeat.

programmes.st: A Joint Mission With the Sand
programmes.d: Shikadai, Inojin, and Cho-Cho's Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Shinki, Yodo, and Araya from the Hidden Sand to find and retrieve an Otsutsuki Puppet that Shikadai had once fought
Shikadai, who also experienced Deepa's frightening power, tells Boruto that a rematch with Deepa would be reckless
Under Kakashi's watchful eye, Boruto succeeds in powering up his own style of Rasengan. Sasuke and Sakura switch places to train their daughter.
Iwabe, Denki and Metal pay a visit to Boruto after he lands in the hospital from overtraining.

programmes.st: The Secret Behind the Underground Room
programmes.d: Konohamaru and Mugino receive intel that the Feudal Lord of the Land of Valleys will be touring the company, giving them the opportunity to check the inner reaches of the secretive facility.

programmes.st: The Revival of the Divine Tree
programmes.d: Boruto and Sarada rush to Victor's research lab where they find a horrifying plant stealing the chakra of the people near it
Separated from Boruto and Sarada, Konohamaru battles Victor. But someone unexpected shows up to fight alongside him.

Konohamaru and his teammates report their findings that the Kara receives outside assistance from people called Outers, and that these Outers may have covertly infiltrated the Five Great Shinobi Nations.
The Yamanaka Clan, who have been tracking the village’s ingoing and outgoing traffic with their advanced sensory abilities, spearheads a plan to create a new sensory system.
A memorial service is being held in remembrance of the many fallen from the Fourth Great Ninja War.
The mysterious organization known as the Kara is about to take one of their plans to the next stage that involves a crucial item called a “Vessel.”
Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki are assigned to carry out Team 7’s missions by themselves until Konohamaru returns from an unexpected assignment.
The airship transporting Kara’s Vessel has gone missing, and the Inners call an emergency meeting.
Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and transport a Scientific Ninja Tool. Stuck on a mission he doesn’t like, Boruto runs into Ao while aboard the Thunder Train headed to their destination.
Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development, and is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.
Team 7, along with Katasuke and Chamaru, the Ninja Hound, go to the location where Konohamaru and Mugino's communications cut out and they are attacked by mysterious puppets.
After allowing Boruto and the others to escape, Ao is visited by Koji Kashin.

A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.
The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.
A teenager is found murdered on a construction site. Grissom, Sara, and Warrick follow the lead of blood on a hammer.
The lone holdout on a jury is found dead in the jury room. The eleven jurors who were voting guilty and who hated the dead juror are the natural suspects.
A woman found murdered in her home. Her resemblance to Sara causes Grissom to take a personal interest in the case and forces him to examine the decisions he has made in his life.
Grissom, Sara, and Nick respond to an electrocution at a casino. The casino is hosting Japanese antiquities. The electrocution is just a ruse to steal the central piece of the exhibit.
A robbery at a grocery store results in a shootout leaving five dead. The police officer at the scene believes Grissom has a grudge against him.
The whole team must investigate a crime where a husband and his porn star wife were murdered execution-style.
Catherine and Sara deal with the death of what at first seems to be a transvestite.

A mutilated female body is discovered tied to the undercarriage of a bus carrying prisoners from a women's correctional facility after a severed arm flies out from beneath the vehicle and strikes a car.
A violent murder in a casino parking garage and another episode in the police interview room lead the CSIs to one shocking discovery after another.

Warrick, Catherine, and Nick try to determine the cause of a house fire that kills a teenage girl. The fire is in the same neighborhood as a similar arson fire. Grissom and Sara investigate a man found dead with letter tiles in his stomach.

Grissom, Catherine, and Nick investigate the death of a runner during a competition. Meanwhile, Sara and Warrick investigate the death of a couple in a hotel room, initially thought to be a murder-suicide.
A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.
Horatio Caine has decided to protect a mixed martial arts fighter from his dangerous brother who recently escaped from prison.
When the CSIs find a co-ed dead in a hot tub, they investigate a case marked by jealousy, psychosis and college roommates.
When Horatio Caine chases down a mysterious murder suspect, he discovers that the man's entire life is an elaborate charade.
After Horatio captures the last prison escapee, their transport plane crash lands, and they discover the fugitive has more planned than a getaway.
A dangerous investigation leads the CSI team down a treacherous road that will lead to the tragic loss of one of their own.
Yelina's life is in danger when the Horatio and the CSI team works a case to convict a rapper suspected of a Miami-style drive-by.

A woman is pushed in front of a moving Metrorail train and both her boyfriend and his stalker ex-girlfriend are suspected of her murder.

A jury field trip to the scene of a murder flips the legal tables when the defendant ends up dead and the twelve jurors become the prime suspects.
A “Speed Dating” night for Miami singles turns deadly for one South Beach stud who finds himself on the wrong end of a tire iron.
Miami Beach is evacuated for a tsunami, but the CSI team remains after discovering a bank robbery plot while investigating a seemingly random murder.
A string of dead bodies, found off the coast of Miami, turns out to be the work of modern-day pirates. Horatio and the team investigate.
An innocent man is killed when someone falls on him from a balcony. The CSI team is lead into the center of a high-level sex and murder scandal.
A seemingly random carjacking turns out to be anything but when a young woman's gambling addiction becomes more than the family business can support.
A hospital emergency room shootout investigation puts the CSI team in the middle of a murder case involving the leader of a prominent street gang
A routine traffic stop ends in the murder of a patrolman. The CSI team must sort out a young girl's obsessive love affair in order to find the killer.
A former medical examiner is found murdered, a white powder found at the scene provides the CSIs with a major lead in tracking the killer.
When a Native American chief is shot, the CSIs struggle to translate which one of the several foreign suspects may have caused his death.
While investigating the shooting of a man in an empty theater, Stella realizes that the crime scene is oddly familiar and staged.
When a man falls 52 stories to his death, and his body goes missing after it hits the ground, the CSIs must treat this as a missing persons case.

Paige finds herself transported back in time to an era of free love and free magic, where she discovers Grams, a peace-loving hippie, who is on a crusade to rid the world of evil through the magical power of love.

After Piper vanquishes a demon from Wyatt's room, she has an epiphany about the rest of her life concerning Wyatt. Unable to handle Piper's revelation, Paige and Phoebe decide to remind Piper of the importance of love by conjuring up a 'Mr. Right.'

Jason breaks up with Phoebe when he finally learns her and her sisters are really witches. Meanwhile, Richard attempts to free himself of his family's karma, and Piper and Paige try to vanquish a group of Swarm demons.
The Charmed Ones help out Leo's mentor, Gideon, when he wants to find out who cast the spell of darkness over a magic school and conjured the Headless Horseman who has been beheading the teachers.

When Phoebe frees a genie from a bottle, she soon finds that she must take the genie's place. Meanwhile, anxious to put Leo and Piper back together, Chris uses Phoebe to make his wish come true, but she takes his instructions too literally.
Gideon makes a deal with the Darklighters to get rid of Leo, but they accidentally send Leo and Piper to the Ghostly plane, leaving Phoebe and Paige to believe that they are both dead.

Phoebe accidentally casts a spell on herself that allows her wild teenage personality to take over, and teen Phoebe is eager to use her magic to her advantage. Meanwhile, Piper asks her father to find out why Chris is avoiding her.
When Piper is kidnapped and cocooned by the Spider Demon, and Chris becomes infected with the Demon's venom, causing him to mutate into a spider demon, Paige, Phoebe and Leo try to rescue them.
When Phoebe and Paige are caught on tape using their powers, the Cleaners, cover up the situation by implicating Darryl as a murderer. When the sisters try to help, they end up on trial instead.

programmes.st: A Wrong Day's Journey Into Right
programmes.d: With Piper away at magic school and Phoebe without her active powers, overworked Paige conjures Mr. Right for stress relief but, unknowingly, releases his evil twin, Mr. Wrong.

Under the pressure that the Halliwell sisters will discover his evil plot, Gideon conspires with two demons to make Piper, Phoebe and Paige part of 'Witch Wars', a new demonic reality television show.

programmes.st: It's A Bad, Bad, Bad, Bad World, Part 1 & 2
programmes.d: Gideon creates a portal that puts Chris and Leo in a mirrored world where evil prevails, and Phoebe and Paige travel to the parallel universe to rescue them. Meanwhile, Piper gives birth to baby Chris.

A grief-stricken Piper and Leo attend a Hindu wedding, where they inadvertently receive the powers of Hindu gods, and it's up to Phoebe and Paige to keep them from consummating their love in order to save the universe.

The Charmed Ones have their hands full, when thanks to a bored Magic School student, they must keep Lord Dyson from killing the infamous Lady Godiva before she can travel back in time and complete her famous ride.
When Paige and Phoebe summon Grams for Chris' Wiccaning, Grams puts a spell on the children to try to end their sibling rivalry, but instead it reverts the sisters back to bickering teenagers.

When Paige encounters Captain Black Jack Cutting, an 18th century pirate in search of the Fountain of Youth, the curse on his life becomes her problem. Meanwhile, Leslie manipulates a contest in order to spend time with Phoebe.
Norm tries to prove his manliness when his new client makes advances.
Sam hires a brilliant artist to paint Diane as a peace offering.
Diane defends her relationship with Sam to a slandering artist.

In the aftermath of their explosive separation, Sam has fallen off the wagon with a thud and has returned to his playboy ways, while Diane has just returned from a self-imposed rest at Golden Brook Sanitarium.
After several sessions with Dr. Frasier Crane, Sam is getting his life back in order, so Diane feels it's time to tell him the truth about her relationship with the psychiatrist.
Sam gloats when he has reason to believe that Diane is still in love with him.
Frasier asks Sam to escort Diane to an event while he is out of town.
Sam reaps the consequences of getting involved with a married woman.
Coach proposes marriage when he falls in love at first sight.
After Coach's girlfriend Irene wins the lottery, she becomes a socialite and breaks up with him.
Frasier's mom threatens Diane's life when they meet for the first time.
Carla's ex-husband returns with his new bride, demanding custody of their oldest son. The normally feisty Carla shocks everyone at the bar when she agrees to the request.
After moving in with Frasier, Diane develops a chronic allergy and believes his beloved dog, Pavlov, causes it.
Norm decides to live life to the fullest when he gets back his medical test results.
At the bar, Sam's innocent flirtation with an attractive customer, Amanda, gets him into trouble when he doesn't realize she's a member of Diane's therapy group.
Carla wins the favor and admiration of Frasier's esteemed mentor.

programmes.st: The Heart Is A Lonely Snipe Hunter

Sam volunteers to play in a charity softball game against Playboy Playmates.
Sam gets Coach's help to help him pass a geography class and get his high school diploma. But he eventually finds an easier way to pass the course.
Norm jeopardizes Cliff's job when he covers his route for a day.
An old bet forces Sam to choose between getting married or losing Cheers.
An astute reporter visits Cheers and is turned off by Sam's arrogance.

programmes.st: If I Ever Would Leave You
programmes.d: Nick returns to win back Carla's love when his new wife leaves him.
Norm's forced to take a promotion that entails firing employees.
With much trepidation, Diane decides to leave Cheers and travel to Europe with Frasier, who has been offered a temporary position at the University of Bologna.
Carla hires an Englishwoman to fill Diane's place while she's in Europe.
Carla takes revenge on her despised former high school principal.
In a cliff-hanging season finale, Frasier proposes to Diane while in Europe, wanting to get married the very next day.
Frasier returns to Cheers with news that Diane joined a convent.
Sam and Diane surprise Woody with a visit from his hometown girl.
Diane finds a coat and believes the mysterious owner is the man of her dreams.
Carla's 16-year-old wants to marry his high school sweetheart.
Diane is convinced the crazed actor from her past is out to get her.

Pro and amateur bakers find creative ways to use hard candies and cereal.

Contestants race to creatively combine doughnuts with potato chips.
Contestants battle it out by creatively combining cheesecake with popcorn.

The bakers are challenged to use beans in campfire classic s'mores.

The bakers try not to crumble when using mangoes in their coffee cakes.
The bakers must feature a cornucopia of corn options in their apple pies.
The bakers have to incorporate soy options in the banana bread challenge.
Great ideas erupt during the lava cake challenge involving lavender.
Bakers and fakers face spiced cream puffs and tea-infused sweets.
Bakers and fakers must make wine in upside-down cakes work in their favor.
The team builds a log potting shed for one of their own.

Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programmes.t: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programmes.d: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

Italian director Franco Zeffirelli stunned the screen world when he cast two young unknowns to portray the star-crossed lovers in Romeo & Juliet, but it was a gamble that resulted in one of the most popular motion pictures of all time.

programmes.t: The Masque of the Red Death
programmes.d: When the sadistic prince (Vincent Price) finds that the Red Death has arrived in the village he rules, he forsakes his people and hides in his castle with his fellow aristocrats…until a mysterious stranger turns his haven into a danse macabre!
A surgeon causes an accident which leaves his daughter disfigured and goes to extreme lengths to give her a new face.
A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.
A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.
The high-spirited taxi gang helps a jittery Bobby fight potential disappointment when he decides that he will end his stage career if he doesn’t get an acting job before midnight.
Mechanic Latka Gravas faces deportation unless he marries a U.S. citizen. The taxi gang comes to his rescue by pitching in and hiring a local working girl to be his bride.
John and his new wife, Suzanne, reach a crisis point in their marriage when one of them must drop out of college due to financial woes.
A Christmas party at the garage is interrupted when Louie, the dispatcher teams up with Alex in a game of high-stakes poker against his cardshark brother Nick.
The taxi gang scrambles to come up with a scheme aimed at ending a one-sided romance when a determined, pretty cabbie sets her cap for Tony and joins the Sunshine Cab Co. to be near him.
Alex feels sympathy for a fare who’s a real loser with the women and arranges a date for the man with Elaine, who later discovers that her klutzy companion for the evening is a U.S. Congressman.

Bobby’s career dreams come true when he lands a role in a soap opera, prompting him to throw his torn-up cabbie’s license at Louie, but the dispatcher vows to take revenge if Bobby ever comes crawling back.
After an operation, Louie, the sharp-tongued dispatcher, panics when he has to keep a promise that he made to God during surgery to turn over a new leaf.
Mike's Air Reserve squadron falls apart during his absence.
Bub wins a contest on TV.
The boys must take care of a bird and a girl.
Steve warns Chip to respect others' property.
Mike learns the secret to business in psychology class.
Robbie's class project involves making investments.
Bub's old friend, a baseball team manager, comes to town to accept an award.
Bub tells the boys about his youth.
Chip faces a life-or-death problem.
Robbie's blind date turns out badly.

While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. 'Looney Luke' Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programmes.st: You And Your Big Shrunken Head
programmes.d: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programmes.st: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programmes.d: Lisa's 'Mudder' pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

Walter's out of town and Maude's life is threatened by an oversexed housepainter. With Arthur on night duty at the hospital, Maude and Vivian barricade themselves in the house and drink a little wine to ward off the cold. and a severe case of hysteria.
Maude is ecstatic over the prospect of seeing a close friend at their college class reunion, but when her friend arrives in a wheelchair, Maude heads straight for the punchbowl.
Maude's investigation into Vivian's erratic behavior reveals a new part of the Harmon's marriage and almost all of Vivian.
Maude's Aunt Lola, who is irresistible to married men -- and vice versa -- zeros in on Mrs. Naugatuck's husband, Bert, as her next conquest.
A woman that is helping to develop a revolutionary new type of television set disappears without a trace, and the company that she works for asks Barnaby to find out what happened to her.

Betty's cousin Foxey Dolan comes into town and sets her and Betty up for a night out on the town with a man she just met. He also happens to be on the run from crooks he's stolen from, and they'll kill to get their goods back.

Barnaby grudgingly begins to suspect that an arson investigator that he has trusted for years is involved in setting fires and then ruling them as accidental in order to get a cut of the insurance money.

Betty becomes a key witness after a boxing promoter she had just visited falls to death from his balcony, and it's ruled a murder. Betty is then stalked and threatened by a blonde woman, whom the prime suspect saw with the promoter.

After spending a year in a sanitarium Barnaby's niece is suspected of shooting and killing the family lawyer during a blackout episode. Barnaby suspects someone is giving her powerful hypnotic drugs to manipulate her behavior.
The father of a robbery suspect killed by Keller insists his boy was unarmed.
One of the girlfriends of a young charmer learns that he has robbed a bank.
In order to stop a psychotic priest killer, Lt. Stone goes undercover as a Roman Catholic priest. The victims were all clergymen who studied at the same seminary.
A cop who finds out that he has a terminal illness sets out to kill a racketeer who's been his quarry for the last year and a half.
An operation run by the syndicate is burgled by a small-time crook.
McGarrett & Five-O protect singer Chelsea Merrimam from assassination by Hawaii kingpin Koko Apaleka, who seeks to eliminate her. McGarrett determined to save Chelsea & nail Apaleka.

Helen Hayes guest stars as Danny's visiting Aunt Clara. The murder of Clara's plane seatmate leads McGarrett to a small band of crooks stealing from abandoned bank accounts, money belonging to Hawaii.

Stabbed critically, a college football star is brought to a hospital by two other stars of the team, instigating a Five-O investigation involving the son of a well-known U.S. Senator and a cold-blooded cover-up of a gang rape.
Five-O's McGarrett framed for possessing stolen art while investigating smuggling ring. Must clear name, find true culprit & solve case. Guest starring Edward Asner.

Five-O officer Danny Williams, a European royal family visiting Hawaii, and potentially many other people are periled by a deranged youth who is using a stolen vial of super-lethal nerve gas in an attempt to avenge his dead father.

McGarrett and team investigate the murder of a former Japanese spy, an aged importer, believed to know the location of a hidden WW2 gold fortune. The killer may be searching for treasure before importer's son arrives from the mainland.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: When Sgt. Lonnie Jamison picks up Jana Craven and her friends for cutting school, a simple truancy bust turns into a complicated murder case for the Sparta police involving the disappearance of Jana's mother, Colleen, and her abusive father, Frank.
In Washington, D.C., Kimble gets the protection of an African Ambassador, but he incurs the hostility of the Ambassador's wife.
Kimble falls in love with a girl who happens to be a daytime parolee from a woman's prison.
When Steve is shot and falls into a coma, Mark does all in his power to find the assailant, even threatening a suspect with bodily harm.
This episode takes place four months after Mark was convicted of murder. Steve is slowly recovering from his wounds and Mark is still rotting in prison.
A hospital emergency preparedness drill turns deadly when an unpopular and ambitious nurse is found dead amid the chaos with an eccentric artist the only witness.
A spat between a girl and her boyfriend leads to an apparent murder, leaving the girl and her mother with a dead body, just as dinner guests Mark and Amanda arrive.

The skeletal remains of a teenage Native American boy are found on a construction site. The boy was murdered eight years earlier. Walker feels the spirit of the Native American who helps him solve the mystery of his death.

A group of cops execute criminals that beat the justice system. After a few murders, the Rangers figure out the pattern and try to track down the bad cops. When an innocent person is killed, Walker makes it his job to stop the group.

An agricultural company produces cattle feed that contains a virus. Instead of recalling the feed, they let the virus spread for research and a way to make it better. The virus affects almost everyone in town.

Alex is about to prosecute a man named Karl Mayes. She learns that he hired her father to defend him. Alex's father is a recovering alcoholic and Mayes gets him to drink. Eventually, he's not sure if he can defend Mayes.

An investigation into the theft of a state-of-the-art military helicopter for use in the drug trade leads Walker to a former fellow Marine Corps officer, who abandoned his unit 25 years ago in Vietnam.
MacGyver is called on to rescue an American cargo pilot being held on espionage charges in Central America.
MacGyver contemplates resigning from the Phoenix Foundation.

A head injury resulting from a confrontation with hitmen who fear MacGyver knows too much about their assassination plot against the leaders of the Omega Forceanti-terrorist brigade, causes MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson) to lose his memory.
MacGyver travels to Czechoslovakia to rescue a dissident from the top-security psychiatric ward of a Czech hospital.
A madman charges into a Lamaze class with a bomb, claiming that a fertility doctor was cheating him. Everything is complicated further when said doctor turns up dead.
Ratings seeking stunts by TV talk show hosts Darren & Mary have tragic results.

Mama can't get anyone to go to the cemetery with her, so she just goes by herself. After arriving and having a long talk with Carl, she notices that the grave that is reserved for her actually has another woman there.

Mama's sister, Frannie, has just passed away, and she is determined to give her late sister something she never had a "perfect day." But things soon turn from perfect to terrible as one disaster after another strikes.
When Robbie's class harasses a substitute teacher, he gets into a lot of trouble at home.
Mike and Sally argue over the wedding.
Mike and his Air Force Reservist friends collect money for a surgery for a disabled girl.
There's more than their girlfriends at risk if the boys' team loses.
Tramp is scheduled for a film audition in Hollywood.
Mike and Robbie take a song to a New York publicist.
Ernie and Chip reenact "Tom Sawyer."
Steve must take in a delinquent as a houseguest for a week.
Mrs. Wilson knits several baby booties to use as covers for a new set of golf clubs, and Dennis quickly spreads word around the neighborhood.
Mr. Wilson wins an essay contest that requires the entrants to be parents, so he tries to pass off Dennis and his friends as his own children.
Dennis and Tommy decide to use pigeons in the park to send messages to each other.
Mr. Wilson becomes a cat-catcher for the police department to help enforce a cat license law.
With Henry away in New York on business and Alice having to spend the night with Henry's mother, Dennis stays with the Wilsons for a night.
Dennis takes Mr. Wilson's lawn edger without asking, so when Mr. Wilson sees Mrs. Elkins using an edger she recently purchased, he takes it believing it was stolen from him.
Mr. Wilson thinks his property taxes are rising because the school is wasting money on nonessential programs and luxuries.
A famous actress commissions Mr. Wilson to write her life story thinking he is a young, vigorous author with a youthful point of view.
Marcia nominates Mike for a Father of the Year award.
The Brady kids fight over what to buy with their trading stamps.
Mike and Carol plan a camping trip for the whole family.
Bobby runs away when he feels underappreciated and unloved.
Carol gets laryngitis right before singing at the Christmas service.

programmes.st: To Move Or Not To Move
programmes.d: The kids are at each others' throats. The basic cause of the problem is that the house is seemingly too small with six kids sharing two bedrooms and one bathroom.
The Bradys comb the neighborhood in search of runaway dog Tiger.
Marcia becomes convinced she's ugly, ugly, ugly! after having to wear braces.
Mike and the kids run the house while Carol is out of town.
Peter’s ego inflates after saving a girl from an accident.
Jan gets a locket from a secret admirer. As the family try to determine who anonymously sent the locket, they're momentarily distracted when Jan loses the locket.
Marcia falls for a boy who is more interested in bugs than girls.

Mama discovers Fran is worth $35,000 and stipulates that a portion would be split evenly between Mama, Vint, and Naomi. One stipulation stands between Mama and the money, she has to keep from losing her temper for 2 weeks.

Ellen stops by with a gift for Mama and to attempt to once again apologize for missing her Aunt Fran's funeral. Mama refuses to forgive her and throws her out. Later, the family learns that Ellen is in the hospital.
When Mama's dreams start providing the names of winning horses, the family figures they're in the money.

programmes.t: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programmes.d: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programmes.d: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.
Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.
The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra.

programmes.t: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programmes.d: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.
A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.
The case of a gruesome stabbing death of a bullied teenager remains unsolved for 27 years.

After U.S. Navy sailor disappears in 68, the Navy claims he went AWOL. But his sister works for over 30 years to prove that he was really killed. And DNA from a cigarette butt helps detectives to unravel a 20-year-old case of rape and murder.

On a summer night in 1987, a 17-year-old girl to come home is found raped and strangled near the Hudson River. And In 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work. The crime remains unsolved for two decades.

While hiking with husband Dennis in Montana, Leslee Larson fell into Wolf Creek. Then Dennis is convicted of murdering his wife, while in Main. And 15-year-old papergirl Penny Parker goes missing, then her body is found by a search volunteer.

A videotape made at an ATM machine helps police in Louisville, KY, to nab a man suspected of raping 13 women. And a DA investigator in Georgia helps crack a murder case that his father, a police chief, first worked on 30 years before.

In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.
Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.
The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.

On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

The U.S. reluctantly accepts the Statue of Liberty, Sybil Ludington goes on an epic ride to warn of a British attack, and journalist Nellie Bly infiltrates a corrupt mental institution. Featuring Laura Dern, Taran Killam, Juno Temple and Matt Walsh.

Scientist Percy Julian overcomes racial barriers, Claudette Colvin refuses to give up her bus seat months before Rosa Parks's famous protest, and Joe Louis fights German boxer Max Schmeling. Featuring Jordan Peele, Terry Crews and "Weird Al" Yankovic.

Alan Freed becomes one of the first radio DJs to broadcast rock 'n' roll, Kris Kristofferson gets his big break with some help from his hero, Johnny Cash, and Sylvia Robinson creates The Sugarhill Gang. Featuring Johnny Knoxville, Jack McBrayer and Retta.

Abraham Lincoln tries to avoid assassination on the way to his inauguration, Francis Scott Key writes "The Star-Spangled Banner," and Edgar Allan Poe feuds with Rufus Griswold. Featuring Charlie Day, Adrianne Palicki, Jesse Plemons and Jason Ritter.

Charles Sumner gets caned on the Senate floor, Judge J. Waties Waring helps to end segregation, and a slave named Robert Smalls commandeers a Confederate warship. Featuring Patton Oswalt, Johnny Knoxville, Busy Philipps and Brandon T. Jackson.

Orson Welles's "Citizen Kane" angers William Randolph Hearst, animator Ub Iwerks helps Walt Disney create Mickey Mouse, and Nancy Reagan convinces her movie-star husband to enter politics. Featuring Jack Black, Tony Hale, Nick Kroll and John Lithgow.

James Cook "discovers" Hawaii and parties with the natives, Japanese-American Daniel Inouye fights heroically in World War II, and Eddie Aikau becomes one of the world's greatest big wave surfers. Featuring Ken Marino, Jason Mantzoukas and Steven Yeun.

Frances Cleveland becomes the youngest first lady ever, Edith Wilson runs the country after Woodrow Wilson's stroke, and Dolley Madison saves several artifacts from destruction. Featuring Courteney Cox, Bobby Moynihan, Alia Shawkat and Casey Wilson.

Baron von Steuben helps train the Continental Army, John Adams and Thomas Jefferson campaign against each other for president, and Benedict Arnold betrays George Washington's army. Featuring Winona Ryder, Chris Parnell, Stephen Merchant and David Cross.

Jim Thorpe is named the greatest athlete of the 20th century, Babe Didrikson breaks down gender barriers in sports, and Jim Abbott achieves prominence as a pitcher despite having only one hand. Featuring Jason Momoa, Zach Gilford and Emily Deschanel.
