(4/4) The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size.

programmes.st: Horror of Fang Rock: Part One
programmes.d: The Doctor and Leela are on Fang Rock island where a murderous creature is at large.

programmes.st: Horror of Fang Rock: Part Two
programmes.d: A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock as an alien menace stalks the island.

programmes.st: Horror of Fang Rock: Part Three
programmes.d: The survivors are in the lighthouse, but the Doctor is still worried about the creature.

programmes.st: Horror of Fang Rock: Part Four
programmes.d: The alien Rutan begins to pick off the remaining humans one by one.
Cesar tries to help bring peace to Jennifer Lee Pryor's home, where fights have been breaking out among foster dogs and her own four dogs; an aggressive beagle.
A Yorkshire terrier who became aggressive after going blind; a spoiled Pekingese/miniature poodle mix; a Rottweiler with a dangerous obsession with the horses on the ranch where she lives.
A Lab-greyhound mix has aggression problems; a Rhodesian Ridgeback-boxer mix has severe dog aggression.
A Yorkshire terrier barks too much; a once-shy German shepherd becomes aggressive; a shepherd mix has a whining problem.
Cesar tries to help an aggressive Shiba Inu from Japan and meets a wire fox terrier who has a fixation with a riding lawn-mower.
Cesar revisits some of his toughest cases and sees how being on the show changed not only the dogs, but the lives of the owners.
A dog with a dark side has a knack for stalking and killing small animals; a poodle chases cars; a bulldog has an adverse reaction to skateboarders.
A rescued dog is too ferocious; an insane Great Dane upsets a household; playing matchmaker for a lonely but picky boxer.
Pets abandoned during Hurricane Katrina reunite with their owners or find new homes; a pit bull behaves aggressively toward the dog of his owner's new girlfriend; a large dog has pica.
Rottweilers with behavior problems; a small mixed-breed fails two obedience classes; a vizsla needs help adjusting to a move from the country to the city.
A Doberman mix instigates fights at the dog park; a Pomeranian charges other dogs; an aggressive terrier mix.
Actress Denise Richards needs help getting in control of her three dogs; a miniature pinscher bites visitors; a lazy basset hound.
A woman's aggressive dogs are coming in between her and her husband; a German Shepherd who failed obedience school; a Sheltie barks in the car and bites other dogs.
A lab-beagle mix needs help to be socialized; a woman worries about the aggressive behavior of her new husband's dog; a Shar-Pei behaves aggressively toward the TV.
A Maltese tries to bite and attack people; a spoiled Pomeranian; a Rottweiler vents his aggression on shopping carts.
A follow-up on the Hurricane Katrina dogs Cesar took; a German shepherd mix is difficult to walk; a chocolate lab refuses to walk on her family's new hardwood floors.
A dog develops an aggression problem after moving to a new area; a big dog does not let people near her owner; a beagle sniffs continually.
Dora, Boots, and Verde the clean-up truck need your help on an adventure to clear up a flood at Party Park in time for Verde's birthday party! ¡Vámonos!

programmes.st: Dora and Perrito to the Rescue
programmes.d: With her brave dog at her side, Dora races on her scooter to the Big River so they can rescue Boots.
Dora, Boots, and Abuela are exploring the rainforest looking for the secret door to Adventure Forest! It's a magical forest amusement park that Abuela used to go to when she was a little girl!
Dora is reading a book of nursery rhymes to Abuela's kitty, Lucky. Lucky loves the one about the three little kittens who ring the bells on their mittens as they dance and sing!
Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to stand up to a bully named Big Wheeler and open the Skate Park for everyone.
After helping Sparky the horse feel better, Dora goes on one more ride with him before bringing him back to the barn.
Dora takes a magic cape back to the prince's castle so she can break the spell that turned the prince into a lion.
Dora and Boots return to the Snowy Forest to help the Snow Princess defeat the Ice Witch in a skating contest and win back everyone's ice skates.
It's time for the Rainforest Talent Show, but first Dora and Boots have to rescue Benny so he can tell his jokes in the show.

programmes.st: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs
programmes.d: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.

programmes.st: Dora and the Very Sleepy Bear
programmes.d: Dora and Boots try to keep a very sleepy Baby Bear awake long enough to get her home for her winter nap.
Dora, Emma, and Kate help Gus the bus take all of the instruments to the kids at music school.
Dora and Boots need to help the Fairy Godmother fix her magic wand, so she can get her puppy back!
Dora, Boots, and Diego set out to rescue their bunny, turtle and butterfly animalito friends and bring them back home to their Copal Tree.
Dora and Boots rush to take Dora's Night Light to the Library before it gets too dark for the little chickens' special story time.
Dora and Boots journey deep into the Never-to-be-Seen-Again Forest so they can bring magic water back from Sparkling Lake and save the magic in Fairytale Land.
Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off to meet him.
Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.
What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

Arriving in Washington, Dr. Mike and Sully find it difficult to find anyone to listen to their concerns. Sully is arrested for army desertion, while a plot against the president is overheard. Michaela must break Sully out of jail to expose the conspiracy.
When money becomes short for Sully, he tries everything to make ends meet rather than accept help from Dr. Mike.
Dr. Mike and Sully are traveling through dangerous Indian country when their stagecoach is robbed, and they are abandoned.

Dr. Mike discovers a lump in Dorothy's breast and tries to convince her to have surgery. Hank tries Ladies Night at the saloon, and Jake and Loren have a plan to get free drinks. Colleen deals with hurtful boyish pranks from classmates.
Dr. Mike has a hard time accepting Dorothy's decision not to have the surgery that will save her life. Jake tries to escape the two men who kidnapped him.
The town's Christmas spirit is in question when a family who are Jewish immigrants moves to town.
Sully is appointed Indian agent to the Cheyenne and approaches it in an idealistic fashion. When the food intended for the tribe is diverted and illegal alcohol is plentiful, Sully becomes angry.
A newspaper report of a comet's imminent collision with Earth causes hysteria in town over the end of the world.
Sam Lindsay, an older independent woman, decides to end her medical treatment and take off into the wilderness.

programmes.st: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 1
programmes.d: Colleen and Brian's biological father Ethan returns to town with a new wife, intending to take the children away from Dr. Quinn.

programmes.st: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 2
programmes.d: Colleen and Brian run away to keep their father from taking them away from Dr. Mike and Sully. After they are found, it's discovered Colleen has developed pneumonia. Dr. Mike realizes she has to let them go to save them.
The town puts on a production of Romeo and Juliet. Brian tries to learn what love is so he can write a paper for school.
Dr. Mike convinces Robert E to take a job fixing a train boiler, then finds out it is a dangerous job.
A teenage Belle Star robs the saloon with the Younger brothers and is shot. Dr. Mike takes her home in an effort to show her a real home life, attempting to turn her from her life of crime.
An abrasive Dr. John Porter arrives in town after hearing of the discovery of dinosaur bones.
When Dr. Mike becomes the substitute school teacher, the town gets upset when she teaches the children about evolution.
Dr. Mike and Sully convince Chief Black Kettle that he should move his starving people to a new reservation. Dr. Mike and Sully are both working on wedding presents for each other.

Alexis gets her revenge on Sable when she tells her tankers have sunk; Alexis is devastated when she discovers Dex slept with Sable; as Sammy Jo becomes increasingly fond of Tanner McBride, she is unaware that he is married.

Alexis is emotionally crushed by Dex's affair with Sable; Blake tells Dex and Sable beneath the lake is a Nazi treasure and his father killed Grimes to prevent him from exploiting it; Adam tries to win back Blake's trust so he can spy for Alexis.

Sable unleashes her lawsuit against Alexis; Dex dives into the hidden vault beneath the lake and finds it empty; Zorelli tracks down the uncle of Dominique Devereaux, learning he knows something about Grimes' murder; Alexis leaves for Switzerland.
Blake is a suspect in Elsworth Chisolm's apparent murder; Zorelli is put back on the Grimes case; Charles Matthews warns Blake that Zorelli has been asking him questions about Blake's father.

Jeff and Dex meet with Roger Grimes' wife and learn he has a son; Sable is pregnant and unable to tell Dex that he is the father; Adam has a picture of Jeff and Monica retouched to appear incestuous and then submits it to a sleazy tabloid.

Charles Matthews tells Blake a grim secret; Zorelli finds a bug hidden in his apartment; Alexis tells Monica that Jason Colby isn't her father; Alexis learns she has a Fredrick Stahl original and realizes Blake's deep, dark secret.

Alexis threatens to sue Blake for half of the plundered Nazi treasure unless Sable withdraws her lawsuits against Colbyco. Sable agrees; Krystina leads Fallon to the treasure. They are followed by Dennis Grimes.
As Krystle Grant Jennings prepares to marry wealthy oil tycoon Blake Carrington, Matthew Blaisdel, a former lover, returns to town and causes her second thoughts.

Blake's estranged son Steven returns home for the ceremony, as does rebellious daughter Fallon, who objects to the union. Blake and Krystle reconcile; Matthew is reunited with his wife and daughter; Walter's rig is sabotaged.
Blake and Krystle are married; Jeff Colby pursues a disinterested Fallon; Walter and Matthew form a business partnership; Claudia and Lindsay try without success to resolve their differences.
Urgent business cuts short Blake and Krystle's honeymoon; Steven takes a job working for Matthew Blaisdel; Cecil proposes that Fallon marry his nephew.

Blake invites Matthew to dinner at the mansion to entice him to return to Denver-Carrington; Krystle clashes with head butler, Joseph; Matthew tells Krystle he's still in love with her; Jeff attempts to win Fallon.
Steven's ex-lover, Ted, arrives from New York; Fallon reluctantly marries Jeff Colby; Blake hires Michael, the chauffeur, to do undercover work for Denver-Carrington.
Steven is taunted on the job for being gay; Blake learns of the terms of Fallon's marriage to Jeff; Steven finds himself attracted to Claudia.
Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.
Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

When the RICO case comes crashing down, Angela breaks ranks to form her own A-team; LaKeisha takes a stand of her own while Ghost, Tommy, Tasha, and Angela race against the clock to prove their innocence.
The team suddenly realizes that the twin daughters of a murdered couple are missing.
A man who volunteered in South America fails to return home.
The team searches for a young woman who disappeared while on spring break.
A groom disappears a few weeks before his wedding.
A groom disappears a few weeks before his wedding.
Stephanie finds a way to keep her enemies at bay; the highly anticipated anniversary celebration at Thelma's Place ends sooner than expected.
The Barnes have a big surprise for the Carlisles, forcing Stephanie and Evan to fight fire with fire; Amara receives backlash at work for her prior indiscretions.
Stephanie plays the ultimate trump card with Amara; Bella takes another chance on love, only to wake up to a nightmare; Rondell and Evan are blind-sided.
Evan and Rondell demand justice from Greg; Titus and Amara work to reconcile; Stephanie pushes back against Greg's cousin Natasha.
Stephanie closes in on Evan, Hunter, and Titus; Evan and Rondell are greeted with a blast from their past; Evan and Bella endure the worst nightmare of their lives.
Perla feels the heat; Amara sets a trap; Darcia unveils some life-changing news; Hunter nears the brink of disaster; Stephanie reveals a painful secret.
Stephanie issues an ultimatum; Evan betrays an ally; Amara baits a witness; Damian takes a stand.
Rondell and Evan join forces to save Thelma's Place; an unlikely suspect comes forth as Senior's killer; Amara is taken off guard; Stephen and Hunter release their fury; Perla gets revenge.
Jacob and Kerissa establish their new ministry; Charity desperately tries to reach Kevin; Darius gets an offer that may take him out of Memphis, leaving Grace to wonder where she fits in his life.
When Sophia and Zora are excluded from the upcoming debutante Cotillion, Lady Mae sets out to make things right; Grace is inspired by Basie's sermon; Charity reaches out to Carlton.
Basie's sermon regarding inclusivity in the church goes viral, lighting a fire under Grace and provoking Bishop's suspicions; Kerissa pushes Jacob to get a day job.
A series of recurring nightmares leaves Grace unnerved; Charity looks to take her relationship with Jabari to the next level; Bishop gives Basie an ultimatum.

When the ocean’s deadliest predator returns, even the world’s strongest navy can’t stop it.
Five deadly Megalodons rise from the deep, unleashing chaos across the open ocean.
Two detectives go rogue to take down a hidden drug kingpin. Stars Billy Dee Williams and Robert Carradine.

programmes.t: In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
programmes.d: As war looms in an idyllic kingdom, a man begins a heroic quest to avenge his family. Stars Jason Statham.
George A. Romero's classic horror film where a group in a Florida bunker must confront a zombie horde.
A naïve young man assumes a dead man’s identity in order to join an underworld game of Russian roulette.
A former soldier navigating London's criminal underworld seizes the chance to assume a new identity.
A naïve young man assumes a dead man’s identity in order to join an underworld game of Russian roulette.
Steven Seagal leads a DEA team ambushed while extracting a captured drug cartel boss.
An arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) confronts the morality of his work as he is being chased by an INTERPOL Agent.
Live and breaking news for the entire Los Angeles area.
Live and breaking news for the entire Los Angeles area.
Live and breaking news for the entire Los Angeles area.
The inside scoop on Los Angeles' home teams.
Live and breaking news for the entire Los Angeles area.
Dr. Mike discovers Hank's dark secret -- an illegitimate son.
A famous civil war photographer realizes he may be taking his last picture after Dr. Mike discovers that he is going blind.
Dr. Mike breaks the rules to enter her new horse in an important race.
Dr. Mike must prove that Loren’s sister-in-law did not murder her abusive husband.
A dead man walks when Halloween comes to Colorado Springs.
Jake is accused of killing a Cheyenne brave, and the incident disrupts the town, as well as the friendship between Sully and Cloud Dancing.
Dr. Mike clashes with a traveling faith healer over a cure for Kid Cole’s tuberculosis.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
A severe drought threatens -- and divides -- Colorado Springs at Thanksgiving.
Dr. Mike suspects that Dorothy is spending time with Sully, and Becky thinks Colleen stole her boyfriend.
The children hide a wounded Sully from the cavalry, which has put a bounty on his head.
Monica and Tess are sent to help Russell Greene’s troubled older brother, Joe (guest star Richard Thomas), turn his life around and take responsibility for a car accident that killed two people
Russell’s brother, Joe (guest star Richard Thomas), puts his son Nathaniel’s life in danger when he drives off under the influence of drugs, unaware that the boy is hiding in his car
THE ANGELS’ EFFORTS TO HELP A GROUP OF YOUNG RUNAWAYS BACKFIRE WHEN ONE OF THE STREET KIDS DIES
The angels take the stand for the defense when a farming town, devastated by a terrible drought, takes God to court over intentional infliction of emotional distress
The angels supervise at a summer camp for HIV positive girls and learn that the teens have made a suicide pact

When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!
A determined detective (Chuck Norris) sets out to rescue an aged diamond cutter from the hands of a murderous thief in this action-packed thriller.

Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Lucy's friend Caroline Abbleby decides she'll pay Lucy a visit while on her way to Hawaii, and can't wait for Lucy to introduce her to all the stars she has supposedly befriended. Lucy's only solution is to trick her friend and set the stage for deceit.
Caroline Appleby is visiting from New York and is excited to see all the stars Lucy had promised. Of course Lucy exaggerated her access to celebrities but plans on fooling her nearsighted friend.

Lucy decides that Ricky needs an agent to negotiate more money and cut down on his fruitless personal appearances, so she appoints herself. Her fast talking, no-nonsense actions result in the studio canceling Ricky's contract.
Although Ricky is having lunch with Richard Widmark, he refuses to introduce Lucy because she has become a legend around Hollywood for her crazy escapades.
The Ricardos are going back to New York in one week and Lucy is determined not to leave Hollywood with the proper souvenirs. She's already got a box full of memorabilia but she still wants more.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.
Chip Jackson of MGM asks Ricky to perform at a party but he refuses in favor of a deep-sea fishing retreat. Lucy has a better idea - she tells Mr. Jackson that Ricky would be glad to appear.
When Ricky makes a little money by selling his car, he forgets to tell his New York neighbors who drove out with him to Hollywood that he will buy their return train tickets.

Lucy, unaccustomed to train travel, is sure her trip to New York will be filled with intrigue and romance. When she hears that a jewel thief is on board, she sees herself as the possible heroine of the situation despite Ricky's admonitions to leave.

On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.

Ricky Ricardo's new fame leads to an invitation to appear on a television interview program. The live interview is to take place in their home and Ricky's new agent wants them to move to a more posh apartment.

Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.

Ricky finds Lucy exhausted after a trying day with little Ricky and insists it is time their son started nursery school. Lucy's protests are overridden and Ricky takes young Ricky to nursery school, but the baby comes down with tonsillitis.

Ricky is offered a European booking that is too important to refuse but he can't afford to take Lucy with him. Lucy is furious at the prospect of being left behind, and when Ricky wants to take Fred Mertz along as the tour manager, Ethel too, is incensed.

Lucy is unable to produce her birth certificate to get a passport for the Ricardos' and Mertzes' European jaunt. She calls her hometown for the birth certificate but discovers that none exists for her.
Fred's fear of becoming seasick threatens the Mertzes' and Ricardos' plans for Ricky's European band tour. They are all booked on the ocean liner Constitution for the trans-Atlantic voyage.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.

Lucy is jealous after Ricky dances with Angela Randall, an up-and-coming British actress. She gets Ricky away from her by going to the country estate of Sir Clive Richardson, a prominent English film producer, for a fox hunt he is hosting.

The Ricardos and Mertzes prepare to leave London for Paris, Lucy realizes that they will not have time to visit her ancestral land of Scotland. She was looking forward to seeking out members of the McGillicuddy clan, her distant relatives.
Equipped with an English-French dictionary, Lucy sets out to explore Paris and discover an artist whose paintings will become very valuable – she knows she has "the eye."

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Lucy goes on a hunger strike in order to get Ricky to buy an expensive dress from a famous French designer. He finally gives in but returns the dress when he discovers that Ethel smuggled her food while on the strike.

Fred, managing Ricky's band while on European tour, routes the musicians to Locarno instead of Lucerne. Ricky is distraught and Lucy suggests a hike in the Alps with the Mertzes to take his mind off his problems.

Fred Mertz, managing Ricky's European band tour, is very concerned over the expense incurred when he misrouted Ricky's band so he books second-class train passage for the overnight trip to Florence and a fourth-class hotel for their stay.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, "Bitter Grapes".

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Every decision counts as the artists choose someone else's tattoo design and make it their own in a true test of adaptability.
As the women's team plots to dismantle the men's team, the judges unveil a combination of detail design and cover-up challenges that are helmed by two domineering coaches.

programmes.st: Put Your Ink Where Your Mouth Is
programmes.d: With only seven competitors remaining, the canvases hold all the power as the artists are challenged to out-market their rivals and work outside their creative comfort zones.
The artists paint custom wheelchair spoke guards in the flash challenge and show finesse as they take on difficult back-of-the-neck tattoos in the elimination tattoo.
The final five artists are tasked with creating murals using paintball guns, then must work across disciplines in a traditional illustrative portrait elimination challenge.
To earn a spot in the finale, the final four artists endure a grueling, blind-judged tattoo marathon and then endeavor to reinterpret a rival's best work.
Seven coaches compete in the Clash of the Coaches Face-Off, the final three artists unveil their 35-hour back pieces, and one artist wins $100,000 and the Ink Master title.
The artists tattoo their home states and face blind critiques by the judges, a competitor makes a drastic choice, and patriotic tattoos decide someone's fate in the Face Off.

programmes.st: Ink Master Clash of the Collages
programmes.d: The South aims to unify and rebound when the teams are tasked with a postcard mural on the side of a bus, and a compass rose elimination tattoo includes a game-changing twist.

programmes.st: Ink Master Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
programmes.d: Teams must unify or die in a two-day tattoo marathon that's all about collaboration, then the losers fight for survival with full-bodied American traditional fairy tattoos.
To test legibility, the teams spin intricate designs with yarn on outdoor canvases, then get technical with schematic tattoos.

programmes.st: Ink Master Out of Your Element
programmes.d: To test their consistency, each team must work on a single canvas at the same time to create a tattoo series representing either earth, wind, water or fire.
After the teams create colorful murals by inserting cups into chain-linked fences, the artists are tasked with tattooing neon-light pieces.
The teams must prove their adaptability while they each work on multiple tattoos and canvasses at the same time, and the Face Off Tattoo comes with a surprise.
The teams put their knowledge of color theory to the test while concocting candy creations, and new school food is on the menu for the elimination tattoo challenge.

programmes.st: Ink Master Artistry On The Line
programmes.d: Competitors must win a suspended-art flash challenge for the right to assign canvases in the notoriously difficult pinup tattoo elimination.

programmes.st: Ink Master Every Artist for Themselves
programmes.d: The 10 remaining artists must set themselves apart from their regional teams and face off in head-to-head individual battles, and two competitors are sent home.
Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

programmes.st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

programmes.st: Battle Against the Dried-Up Demons at the Cultural Festival!
programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
programmes.d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

programmes.st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.
At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 1
programmes.d: Sara, a mysterious woman, appears before Sara. Sara was once saved by Sesshomaru. She was reincarnated just as she had died from an illness.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2
programmes.d: Sara asks Sesshomaru to destroy her along with the spirit. Sesshomaru complies, and uses the Tessaiga to destroy Sara along with the spirit.

programmes.st: The Last Banquet of Miroku's Master
programmes.d: Priest Mushin, the person who raised Miroku, is going to die. Miroku and the others are shocked.
A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

programmes.st: Eternal Love: The Naginata of Kenkon
programmes.d: Tsukiyomi, who is supposed to be dead, possesses Kagome and appears before Hoshiyomi.
Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.st: Bizarre Guards at the Border of the Afterlife
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.st: The Fiery Bird Master, Princess Abi
programmes.d: When the gateway in the Land of Fire opened, Kagome sensed the presence of the Sacred Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 1
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 2
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.
In order to defeat Naraku, Kagura looks for Sesshomaru. She appears before Rin and Jaken, but Sesshomaru is away.

programmes.st: The Mysterious Light that Guides the Saint
programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Overcame Time…and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome.
Kagome finds out that she may be the reincarnation of Kaede's late older sister, the priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha with her arrow.

programmes.st: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
programmes.d: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel.
Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body.
Kagome learns that Inuyasha is a half demon, born of a human mother and a dog demon.
The muonna makes Inuyasha reveal the location of his father's grave.
Kagome is able to pull out the Tetsusaiga. Sesshomaru tries to kill her, and Inuyasha is angered and fights to protect Kagome.

programmes.st: The Toad Who Would Be Prince
programmes.d: Nobunaga tries to save the lord of the castle who is possessed by a toad demon.
When Adam reveals his dating past to Jane, the information puts a strain on their relationship.  Lina  seeks Jane's advice about whether she should get married.
Jane's book is finally being released but her plans to have a party at the local bookshop where she was inspired to be a writer hit a snag.
Jane is excited for her first book tour and brings Xo along for fun, but Alba decides last minute that she is going as well.
After Jane and Rafael decide to send Mateo to a new school, they become guilt-ridden when they are forced to lie to get him in.
Jane and Rafael realize that the uncertain state of their relationship is stressing out Mateo and they decide they need to make a decision.
Jane and Rafael try to be friends which works great until Jane goes on a date.  Petra and Jane's new partnership is off to a rocky start, but they know they have to find a way through it.
Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.
Edgardo is accusing Arron of not paying his share of the rent, and is suing for what he thinks is owed.
Two sisters feud over the family heritance ends up in Judge Marilyn Milian's court room
Tyrone claims his ex wife Tania got him falsely arrested 3 times so he's here to sue her for $3,000.
Kentra is here for a paternity test after the man who signed her birth certificate has been in and out of her life.
Ashley is suing her former friend, Terra, for not returning her dog after caring for it while she was in rehab.
Jessica is suing her ex-boyfriend, stating he attacked her after falsely accusing her of sleeping with his cousin.
Liatwanne petitions the court for rehab for her son, saying he's an addict who started using drugs as a teen.
Tania is suing her child's father for not reimbursing her for a cruise his daughter from another woman came on.
Darral has been brought to court after towing Chester's car who he believes was carelessly double parked illegally.
Nicole is suing the man she rented a room from after making her uncomfortable and changing the locks after a fight.

programmes.st: You Sold Me A Sick Puppy!
programmes.d: After Billie's puppy died 6 days after purchase, she demands the seller reimburse her for vet bills, pain and suffering.
Andrew is accusing his ex boss of assault and demands retribution for his back pain after the attack.
Joan is taking Sena to court after she gave away 5 cats she asked Sena to care for after Hurricane Sandy.
LaToya wants her ex-boyfriend to reimburse her for the rental car after finding out he got another woman pregnant.

programmes.st: You Threw Me Out Of Your Taxi
programmes.d: Allison is suing the taxi driver she hired to drive her home after a medical procedure for kicking her out.
Rachel is suing her landlord because she claims he forced her to lose her job.
Destiny is suing her Father for property damage after she claims he damaged the hood of her car.

The Ninja embark on their separate journeys to awaken the Arc Dragon of Focus but deal with unexpected - and annoying - interruptions.

A young park guest accidentally strands himself in the Pteranodon aviary, requiring Owen and a testy Stygimoloch to stage a daring rescue.

A Dilophosaurus runs loose in the park's hotel, and Owen and Claire must find it before the guests notice ... and before Vic's dino-hunting security team can damage the hotel and the guests!

When Moro uses the Realm Crystal to open a portal to the Cursed Realm, ghosts take over the town - but the Ninja, in disguise, manage to get Lloyd to the center of the town and Lloyd steals the crystal…
As the ghosts converge around and mobilize the Preeminent into a hulking giant behemoth, the Ninja use Airjitzu to fight the mobile beast in an attempt to slow it down.
After the defeat of the ghosts and the destruction of the Cursed Realm, the ninja finds themselves famous all over Ninjago.
With Destiny’s Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn.

When Lunia's true identity is revealed, she regales the dream chasers with the epic story of how she became the legendary dream keeper.
The dream chasers hunt for Lunia's hourglass, which they believe will help them defeat the evil Dreamsmasher.
After locating Lunia´s hourglass, the team heads to the dream world's sun, which holds more secrets than the object they're searching for!
Z-Blob returns in a daring rescue to break Mateo out of Dreamsmasher's "box" and helps him find Lunia's hourglass!

Mateo, Izzie, Zoey, and Cooper are unwilling participants in a sleep study at Happy App Headquarters, and it's up to the others to break them out!

Laval and Cragger attempt to get all the tribes to agree on a lasting peace in Chima, but Crooler creates a strange fog that makes everyone very powerful and angry, especially Cragger.

A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
Barney and the children have fun playing with and learning about busses and cars.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
The children work together to make a bird house.  They are happy to learn that the bird will have lots of company; many animals make their homes in the park too!
The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

Barney and the kids help Mr. Boyd prepare his dog Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a check, while learning lessons about caring for dogs at the same time.  Meanwhile, BJ is searching for his missing baseball, which he suspects was buried by Bingo.
Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a performance for their friends in the park.

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend!  When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the "new kid" isn't easy.
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive.  Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.
Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
A day of imaginative play and fun for Barney and his young friends is kicked off by the arrival of a variety of boxes from the "Enjoy-Your-Toys Company."  Surprisingly, every box is empty!
The kids have put together a "Caboose Color Collection" which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue.  Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist.  Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce "triangles."
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them.  And by the end of the day, the kids have learned that big or little, they're all wonderful just the way they are!
Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can.  It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!

When Sarah accidentally spills red paint into the blue paint, a mess turns into a perfectly purple day.  The children paint pictures, make purple flowers and plan a purple party for their friend Colleen.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.

programmes.d: Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.

District Attorney Julie March matches wits with tempestuous author Cynthia Slayton, whose torrid novels are suddenly eclipsed by facts surrounding the death of her best friend.
Matlock becomes embroiled in Attorney/Client privilege issues when he defends two murder suspects whose cases become strangely intertwined.
Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.
Matlock uncovers unflattering secrets about the late mayor of Chicago while defending an aging hippie activist accused of the man’s assassination.
Matlock’s trip to the Windy City to defend a 1960’s radical accused of murdering Chicago’s mayor comes to a head in the second part of this dramatic two-part episode.

When Tony Morgan, a smooth-talking, seemingly perfect son, frames his mother for murder, no one even suspects his involvement. No one except Ben Matlock, who tries to prove the good boy isn’t so good after all.

Matlock is surprised to learn that his long-time client, respected businessman Craig Gentry, is the son of mob boss Sam Gerard. The ace attorney must defend Craig of the murder of a senator who was investigating organized crime.
Matlock has his hands full defending his client, Craig Gentry, while also trying to prevent a full-scale mob war from breaking out between Craig’s father and two of his enemies.
Matlock is accused of bribing a witness.
Ben goes to Baltimore to help Julie defend her best friend's brother only to find that the prosecutor is Julie's ex-husband.

A budding friendship between two great lawyers blossoms into animosity when Matlock and District Attorney Brennen square off on a murder trial. Not only does Matlock believe in his client’s innocence, he thinks Brennen might be the one who’s guilty!

Dozing off into the nostalgic world of the 1930s, Matlock dreams he’s a washed-up, hard-drinking lawyer defending a nightclub owner accused of shooting a saxophone player named Slick, guest star Jeff Conaway.
Matlock reluctantly becomes an angel for a Broadway-bound musical about lawyers when the playwright Sam Spelvin is accused of murdering an acerbic theater critic.
A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

Director of an amateur stage production, Doug Michaels fires would-be actor Ben Matlock from his role as a detective, claiming he’s seen kumquats with more talent. However, the tables soon turn when Michaels is accused of murdering the leading lady.

Ben Matlock recalls in flashbacks the racially tense 1960’s. At the time, he was a defense attorney representing African-American Cyrus Jordan – a talented cook charged with murdering the bullying white sheriff.
An afternoon fishing expedition evolves into a nightmare. Matlock watches in horror as the boat he just disembarked suddenly explodes into a fireball killing his companion, Judge Stern.
Jim Phelps poses as a master chess champion to trap a criminal with a near genius mentality and his mysterious boss.
Imry Rogosh is a mass murderer who kills to foment political upheaval. He is targeting Los Angeles, so the IMF knocks him out in a car accident.

As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Jim Phelps is kidnapped and held for ransom until Barney, Casey, and Willy can steal an incriminating letter from a safe deposit box and turn it over to crime syndicate boss Andrew Metzger.
The IMF races against time to convince the president (Pernell Roberts) of a small country that his chief of secret police plans to overthrow the government and seize power.
The IMF turns itself into a surgical team to operate on a tyrannical ruler who has imprisoned the rightful king, his twin brother, on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.
The IMF foils the attempts of a once-powerful communist to regain power.
Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.
The IMF team must rescue a U.S. intelligence operative who has top-secret military plans on a microcircuit chip.

Kim Hunter guest stars as Hannah O'Connel a brilliant but superstitious criminal who escapes to a Caribbean country and is drawn into a voodoo ceremony by the IMF to locate a cache of stolen gold she has hidden away.
Gangsters running a loan-shark racket in Hawaii short-circuit the IMF team's investigation when they capture Willy and feed him gigantic doses of truth serum.
The IMF hides a young prince from assassins by disguising him as a gypsy girl, then Paris sets out to betray the boy to his pursuers on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

An F.B.I. man is blinded while investigating a crime syndicate attempting to take over a large chemical plant. Jim Phelps undergoes a delicate eye operation so as to appear convincingly blind when he poses as the sightless man.

Double-agent Elena Del Barra is acting bizarrely, sending a microfilm of defense secrets from her own country. Rollin is sent in to investigate and return the microfilm without its theft ever being detected.

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Mister Rogers shows a piece of plastic pipe and talks about tunnels. Mr. McFeely shows up with a video of him driving his car through a car wash. Cousin Mary Owl believes a tunnel may exist under Henrietta Pussycat's and X the Owl's tree.

Chuck Aber demonstrates a small backhoe. Lady Aberlin has a fan, a flashlight and a measuring tape for the owls to use when they go into the tunnel. Mr. McFeely shares a video about how people make tortilla chips.

Mister Rogers shows his control box that makes Trolley go fast and slow. Trolley shows King Friday and Mayor Maggie how it can go very fast and very slow. Neighbor Aber and Mayor Maggie discuss how to get Trolley to slow down.

Mister Rogers reflects on a day when he went roller skating with his friend Stephen Lee. Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about how people make roller skates. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, the Trolley is still moving very quickly.

Mister Rogers has a gift for Mr. McFeely -- the Speedy Delivery Alphabet Book. Lady Aberlin and Prince Tuesday try to cheer up Daniel Tiger who is sad because he cannot say the alphabet as quickly as Prince Tuesday.

Mister Rogers visits Chainey Umphrey and sees a gymnastics demonstration. Lady Aberlin and Neighbor Aber have built a feathered contraption over the Trolley tracks to help them catch the speeding Trolley. Lady Elaine falls on the feathers.

Mister Rogers arrives with a toy crane. When he lifts objects slowly, the crane works perfectly. Neighbor Aber and Corney use a crane to catch the Trolley. Trolley's controls are adjusted back to normal.

Maggie Stewart invites Mister Rogers to her home where she and Chef Brockett are making bread pudding for a family reunion. Prince Tuesday tells Chef Brockett he doesn't like what he sees in the mirror. Chef Brockett tells the King.
Mister Rogers shows a photo book of twins and explains that even though identical twins look alike, each one is unique.

Noticing that each string on Mr. Negri's guitar is different, Mister Rogers makes mention that every person is different. The King asks Lady Aberlin for her help in tending to Prince Tuesday's recent change in mood.
Who does the puppet voices in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe? Mister Rogers shows how he works some of the puppets and visits with the voice of Prince Tuesday.

Mister Rogers arrives with a kazoo and plays it. He shows a film of how people make kazoos.  Neighbor Aber and Lady Aberlin use kazoos to try and call for Corney for his birthday party.  He responds and arrives at the castle.

Renowned artist, Red Grooms, gives Mister Rogers a tour of his studio and the life-size bus "sculpture" he is working on. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Elaine is angry that her Eiffel Tower drawing isn't turning out well.

programmes.st: Mad: Healthy Ways to Express Anger
programmes.d: Mister Rogers explains that there are different ways to deal with mad feelings as some might use art and others may use music. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Elaine is still angry about her Eiffel Tower drawing.

programmes.st: Mad: Things to Do with Our Hands
programmes.d: There are lots of things people can do with their hands. Even when they are angry, they can do things with their hands that won't hurt others.
What do you do with the mad that you feel? Do you pound something, like some play clay or a steel pan? Mister Rogers visits people who make and play steel pans.

Mr. McFeely has a strange package for Purple Panda which was left at the castle, a uniquely shaped orange ball with specific instructions that it is not to be opened. Ms. Ducey shares her adaptation of George Shannon's story, Lizard's Song.
Looking carefully can help children with growing and learning. Mister Rogers has a purple flowered plant and takes time to look at it closely.

Mister Rogers and Marilyn Barnett exercise. Bob Trow brings over a portrait he did of Marilyn. Lady Aberlin is unrecognized because she is wearing sunglasses. Mr. McFeely shows a video of Mister Rogers' television house being set up .

Mister Rogers arrives with a ball float to repair a broken one in his toilet. Lady Aberlin retrieves the package for Purple Panda from the castle's P Room, but it disappears once again as soon as Purple Panda tosses it in the air.

Mister Rogers watches the tape about ducklings. Robert Troll takes Neighbor Aber to the Museum-Go-Round where Lady Elaine has set up a collection of Package Catchers (P.C.'s) in an attempt to capture the mysterious package.

King Friday recites his kingly version of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star as Prince Tuesday struggles to write a poem of his own. Mrs. McFeely is watching a litter of sixteen-day-old puppies and explains the care that they need.
Mr. McFeely brings a video showing how people make vacuum cleaners.

Mister Rogers takes viewers to B. Smith's Restaurant. After viewing the restaurant's walk-in refrigerator, Mister Rogers and Ms. Smith make a custard dessert. Barbara Smith gives Queen Sara a napkin commemorating her new restaurant.

Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make chalk. Mayor Maggie reports that all of the vacuum sweepers in Westwood are missing. King Friday assigns Lady Aberlin, Mayor Maggie and Prince Tuesday to find the missing vacuums.
Mister Rogers meets with some children who are making crafts at the Inner City Art Center in Los Angeles. In Make-Believe, Lady Elaine's friends help her conquer her fears.

Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely look at snow globes and see a film about how people make cereal. King Friday says he is the bravest and strongest in the neighborhood. Cereal is falling like snow. Mister Rogers goes to a Tae Kwon Do class.

Mister Rogers returns a scarf to one of Mr. Brewer's puppets which makes the puppet feel brave and strong. Elsie Jean Platypus tells Lady Abelrin that the cereal quit falling on her because she was not afraid of it.

Mister Rogers visits the McFeelys, who are watching after young lambs. Handyman Negri and King Friday put on full cereal-proof armor. When their efforts fail, it is clear that Daniel is the only one who can stop the cereal from falling.

programmes.st: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
programmes.d: Robin, Usopp, the Tontattas and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo's deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin'emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town.

programmes.st: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
programmes.d: With Luffy & the others recovering from Pica's attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out.

programmes.st: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!
programmes.d: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action.

programmes.st: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
programmes.d: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law's handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him.

programmes.st: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
programmes.d: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through Doflamingo's guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit!

programmes.st: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
programmes.d: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas.

programmes.st: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!
programmes.d: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum.

programmes.st: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!
programmes.d: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks towards a unified plan.

programmes.st: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!
programmes.d: Hidden far underground, Kin'emon finds his old friend Kanjuro whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along.

programmes.st: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!
programmes.d: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.

programmes.st: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!
programmes.d: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky.

programmes.st: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
programmes.d: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.

programmes.st: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
programmes.d: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process?

programmes.st: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
programmes.d: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo.

programmes.st: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
programmes.d: Usopp uses Viola's Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster, and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp's ammunition has been specially designed for this situation!

programmes.st: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
programmes.d: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

programmes.st: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
programmes.d: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

programmes.st: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
programmes.d: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

programmes.st: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
programmes.d: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

programmes.st: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
programmes.d: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!

programmes.st: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
programmes.d: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.

programmes.st: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
programmes.d: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.

programmes.st: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
programmes.d: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.

programmes.st: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
programmes.d: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.

programmes.st: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
programmes.d: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!

programmes.st: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
programmes.d: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

programmes.st: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
programmes.d: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!

programmes.st: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!
programmes.d: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?

programmes.st: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!
programmes.d: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!

programmes.st: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!
programmes.d: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!

Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!

programmes.st: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!
programmes.d: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor's tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!

When the team digs into the circumstances surrounding a car crash that resulted in the death of a photographer, they realize there is more than meets the eye.
After an altercation with a student, teacher Patrick Miller goes missing, leading the team to investigate everyone who might have had a grudge against him.

At 17, Nina drops out of high school and moves to Tokyo alone. Lost in the big city, she is drawn there by a song she found online. On the day she arrives, she meets the street musician who plays that song.

Nina starts cram school after promising her parents she'll try to get into college. Struggling to adjust and focus on her studies, she receives a text from Momoka. When Nina visits Momoka's house, she meets a girl her age.

Nina struggles to focus on her studies, but she has to visit Subaru's school to return her phone. After a heart-to-heart, they begin opening up to each other. Soon after, the trio prepares for their first live show as a band.

Subaru's grandmother unexpectedly visits Tokyo. Subaru wants to pursue music, not acting, but when she tries to tell her grandmother, she puts on a fake smile and plays the role of the good granddaughter instead.

A live house where Momoka used to play asks the girls to perform, and they agree to enter their first battle of the bands. As they struggle to meet the ticket sales quota, Momoka gets tickets to a show by her former band.

The three girls practice to improve as a band. Nina is obsessed with beating Diamond Dust and researches ways to boost their popularity, but finds nothing useful. Tomo and Rupa then approach Nina after seeing the three girls perform.

Tomo and Rupa join Nina, Subaru, and Momoka, forming a five-member band. Momoka finds an upcoming show, but their different personalities clash. Nina and Momoka have different views of the band as they take the stage with their relationship strained.

After the live show, Nina and Momoka's fight intensifies. Nina gives up her escape routes to pursue music professionally. Tomo threatens to quit if their rocky relationship continues. On Nina's first day at work, Momoka shows up.

Traumatized by past experiences, Tomo struggles to express her feelings to the band. When Nina asks for feedback on her guitar playing, Tomo is harsh, but seeing Nina refuse to give up gives Tomo the confidence to change.

Nina's parents visit from her hometown as she dedicates herself to the band. After running away, Nina reluctantly returns home. She tries to talk to her father, but he fails to understand her perspective. The next day, he takes her to her old high school.

At a massive outdoor music festival, Nina and the band are fired up by the huge stage. Diamond Dust has grown stronger, but Nina refuses to lose. Determined to leave their mark, the band begins the performance of a lifetime.

After signing with a talent agency, Nina and the band are challenged by Diamond Dust, who now have twice their followers. Split on whether to accept, they face the battle with low ticket sales—but take the stage and stay true to themselves.

Nina's band falls far behind Diamond Dust in ticket sales for the battle of the bands, facing the harsh reality of their competition. Despite this, Nina and the band stay true to themselves and take the stage to play their song.
