Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions.  Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.
The 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments.  Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

Roy makes mischief at an auction in Toronto with an assortment of classic pranks. Rick and Cindy resort to flashing to grab Don's attention. Ursula vows to take the perfect selfie, and Paul decides Bogart is finally ready for “the talk."

The bachelor party Roy has planned for Bogart is all anyone can talk about. Before the party can begin, Paul and Bogart take care of some adorable business and Rick and Cindy hope to make some money at the track when they meet up with an Olympian.

New buyer Tommy is larger than life and looking for a big score at an auction in Brampton. Roy arrives with an intern, eager to mentor for free labor. Rick and Cindy hedge their bets and Ursula would rather be shopping.

programmes.st: Honeymoon Capital Of The Storage World
programmes.d: The buyers attend an auction in Niagara Falls. Rick and Cindy wonder if Cindy will be recognized in her old hometown. Ursula is in a sticky situation, Roy is better off undead, and Paul and Bogart visit the Ripley's Believe It or Not! Museum.

Paul, Bogart, and their life coach go to an auction in Toronto. If any problems arise, they must “hug it out.” Ursula encourages her daughter to run away to join the circus. Rick takes charge, Cindy doesn't notice, and Roy sets his glass on fire.

programmes.st: Between A Brawk And A Hard Place
programmes.d: Roy reaches new levels of distraction by training a talking parrot to insult the rest of the buyers at an auction in Etobicoke. Rick and Cindy do some detective work, Ursula could use a hand, and Paul and Bogart make money where the sun doesn't shine.

Paul wants his son to be a father someday but is unhappy when Bogart brings a “practice baby” to an auction. Ursula finds out if blondes do have more fun. Rick and Cindy try silent but deadly tactics and no one notices when Roy is more honest.

programmes.st: The Birds And The Bees And The Bulls
programmes.d: The buyers learn lessons at an auction in Ontario. Paul and Bogart discover that listening to each other is useless. Glasses affect Ursula's bidding. Roy learns that his true calling is a frat boy and Rick and Cindy get too much information.

Ursula goes ape at an auction when Roy says her coat makes her look like a monkey. Paul and Bogart set a bad example for returning buyer Jeff Gardner and his son. It takes a lot for Rick and Cindy to bid on their locker and Roy's out for blood.

Roy brings noisemakers to an auction in Emery Village but the other buyers aren't feeling it. Rick and Cindy prefer to clown around on their own time. Paul and Bogart boogie with some intergalactic performers, and all Ursula wants is a strong coffee.

programmes.st: May The Schwarz Be With You
programmes.d: Jeff Schwarz, aka “The Liquidator,” is back and is causing as much chaos as possible.

Paul's daughters return for an auction and decide to work as a team of their own, which ruins the day for Bogart. Roy hopes it doesn't cost him a locker. Rick and Cindy get serious about fitness and Ursula meets soprano Lindsay Sutherland Boal.
After years of searching, the team believes they have found the elusive flood tunnel that will lead them to the Money Pit and Gary discovers a mysterious artifact.
Forgotten clues produce new leads as the fellowship of the dig zeroes in on the Money Pit.
A strange group of children are discovered on an Earth-like planet.
Kirk investigates an experimental facility for holding prisoners and finds a sinister scheme.
Kirk bluffs his way past what appears to be a powerful alien.
Spock hijacks the Enterprise to return an injured Captain Pike to Talos IV.
Spock hijacks the Enterprise to return an injured Captain Pike to Talos IV.
Kirk is one of the last survivors who can identify a mass killer, who lurks among a Shakespearean troupe aboard the Enterprise.
The Enterprise must decide on its response when a Romulan ship makes a destructively hostile armed probe of Federation territory.
A U.S.S. Enterprise landing party beams down to an uncharted planet. The planet seems like a perfect candidate for shore leave with its "Earth-type" characteristics.
Spock commands a stranded away team when their shuttlecraft is stranded on a planet with hostile natives.
A powerful entity known as Trelane torments the crew of the Enterprise.
The U.S.S. Enterprise is in pursuit of an unknown alien ship which has destroyed a Starfleet base.
The U.S.S. Enterprise is thrown into a time warp and ends up orbiting Earth in the 20th century.
Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.
The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru...who intends for them to join his people.
Kirk meets Khan, a notorious dictator, and leader of Earth's Eugenics War.
The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.
The Enterprise visits a colony where indigenous flower spores provide the settlers with peaceful contentment.
A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.
Kira must investigate the man she loves when she learns he may be the Cardassian collaborator responsible for the massacre of forty-three Bajorans.
O'Brien is arrested by the Cardassians and put on trial for a crime he insists he did not commit.
During a trip to the Gamma Quadrant with Jake and Nog, Sisko and Quark are imprisoned by soldiers working for a mysterious power known as the Dominion.
Hoping to avert an invasion, Sisko takes his officers into the Gamma Quadrant to find the leaders of the Dominion
While Odo struggles to learn the ways of his people, Sisko discovers that the price of peace with the Dominion may be too high.
In order to boost his business and gain respect, Quark lies about killing a Klingon, then winds up forced to marry the dead man's widow.
A deadly secret from Dax's past could mean the end of Jadzia's life.
Kira is kidnapped by the Cardassians, who try to convince her that she is really one of their people.
Odo tries to convince a young, violent Jem'Hadar that there is more to life than fighting and killing.
A trapped crew fights to save the station from self-destruction when an automated Cardassian security program is accidentally activated.
Dax falls in love with a man who will soon disappear with his planet into another dimension for sixty years.
Wil Riker's renegade duplicate steals the Defiant and attacks Cardassian territory, forcing Sisko to assist Gul Dukat in stopping him.
A Bajoran celebration on the station serves as the backdrop for an epidemic of inexplicable romantic attractions among the crew.
A transporter accident sends Sisko, Bashir, and Dax three centuries back in time to a crucial point in Earth's history.
Trapped in Earth's past, Sisko must assume a pivotal role in history to try and restore the future.
Bashir must use questionable methods in order to keep Vedek Bareil alive long enough to help bring about a Bajoran peace treaty with Cardassia.

After returning to where they left the Enterprise and finding only the scattered remains of their ship, Trip and Reed struggle to survive and hope for rescue with only a few days worth of oxygen left inside Shuttlepod One.
Encountering a group of Vulcan pilgrims on a mission to explore their emotions, T'Pol is enticed to attempt some of their technique with a handsome and charming pilgrim, Tolaris.
Archer and his crew encounter a group of alien hunters upon a rogue planet that has broken out of its orbit.
The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.
Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.
Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.
Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.
Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.
Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.
The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

As Archer makes his way back from the 31st century to prevent the Sulibans destroying the Enterprise, his crew tries to fend off the violent machinations and interrogations of leader Silik and come up with their own plan to keep the ship safe.

T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

To facilitate a lengthy list of necessary repairs, the crew visits an alien station with a super-computer that can fix anything.  But the automated station's demands for payment seem too good to be true...until Mayweather is discovered dead.
Archer spends a sleepless night tending to his quarantined beagle Porthos and figuring out how to apologize to the quirky, ritualistic Kreetassens he inadvertently offended on a recent visit.
Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.
Loyalty and ethics clash when a paralyzed Worf asks to help him commit suicide.
A rescue mission leads to a dangerous romance between Riker and a rebellious member of an androgynous race.
The Enterprise is trapped in a time warp that forces the crew to endlessly repeat the same experiences.
Caught between loyalty to his friends and the need to tell the truth, Wesley becomes involved in a cover-up when his Starfleet Academy squadron suffers a deadly collision.
Preparing for her wedding aboard the Enterprise, Troi's free-thinking mother causes trouble between Worf and his son.
A beautiful woman, chosen by her people to serve as a peace offering to end a centuries-long war, falls in love with Picard.
A little girl's imaginary friend becomes a frightening reality for the crew when she threatens to destroy the Enterprise.
Picard and the crew suffer from conflicting emotions when the Enterprise rescues a critically-injured Borg.
Geordi and Ro are pronounced dead after a transporting maneuver from a distressed Romulan ship goes awry.
After a mysterious accident, Picard wakes up living the life of another person on a faraway planet.
After Data learns of his own death in late-19th-century San Francisco, a freak accident transports him back to that period.
The Enterprise crew travels between the 19th and 24th centuries in an attempt to prevent Data's death in 19th century San Francisco.
A young Enterprise engineer is forced to confront his paralyzing fear of being transported.
Troi is drastically transformed when a visiting ambassador secretly uses her to achieve his aims.
Trapped in limbo for 75 years, Star Trek's Scotty awakens to join the Next Generation in the 24th century.
Commander Riker's inability to fall asleep begins to show in other members of the crew in other forms, putting the Enterprise on the trail of a mystery.
When an honor student in the medical field is assigned to the Enterprise in an internship manner, she begins to demonstrate powers of the Q, prompting you-know-who to show up.
An enemy attack leaves Janeway and the crew believing they are characters in a World War II holodeck simulation.
World War II happens all over again as a holodeck simulation spills out onto the decks of Voyager.
When the Voyager stops to help an alien repair his ship, the alien switches bodies with Paris.
Voyager comes across a space phenomenon that must be destroyed at all costs.
Chakotay meets a woman he once loved, but he has no memory of her.
Hundreds of years in the future, the Voyager crew is accused of murder.
An alien species tries to populate its planet by duplicating the Voyager crew.
With the fate of the crew in her hands, Seven must face her deepest fears alone.
When Starfleet sends a ship to bring the Voyager crew home, it seems too good to be true.
Janeway's actions could cost the crew their chance of reaching home.
The pupil becomes the teacher when a Borg drone is born on Voyager and Seven of Nine instructs him in the ways of humanity.
A need to test herself leads Torres down a path of self-destruction.
The Voyager crew discovers an alien training ground for the destruction of Earth.
Neelix balks at telling Naomi that her mother and others have gone missing on an away mission.
Fifteen years after making a horrible mistake, Kim attempts to rewrite history.
Seven experiences the Borg version of multiple personality disorder.
Torres is forced to put her life in the hands of a mortal enemy that uses biochemical secretions to give commands.

Sheppard starts to question things when strange malfunctions begin to occur after the team returns from a trip to Earth. The team discovers that the Daedalus has been infected with a Wraith Virus, causing the ship to go into survival mode.

The search for Lt. Ford leads Sheppard and Teyla to planet P3M-736 where they are captured by Ronon Dex, a man who is on the run, being hunted by the Wraith. The team offer to help Ronon, going up against the Wraith once again.

While on Planet Thenora, the team is shocked when McKay and marine officer Laura Cadman are suddenly taken aboard a Wraith Dart. When the team shoots down the Dart, they discover a technical glitch has put Cadman's consciousness in McKay's body.

The team discover a planet that has cruel punishments for anyone who commits a crime; they are placed near the Stargate to be taken by the Wraith. This proves to be too effective forcing the society to put innocent folk in jail to please the Wraith.

The team discover the remains of an experiment the Ancients were working on to create the ultimate power generator and McKay believes he can finish what the Ancients started. Teyla and Ronon discover Ronon is not the last of his kind.

Beckett begins experimenting with a new treatment that could turn the Wraiths into humans. The team finds a young Wraith girl, who could be Beckett's first patient. Having been raised by a human, the girl is eager, and reckless, to try anything.

After being injected with Beckett's Wraith treatment, Sheppard's life is in danger as he slowly is transforming into an Iratus bug hybrid. The team rushes to find a cure and reverse the side effects, but in the end it might be up to Sheppard.

After Colonel Young and his military personnel are captured by the Lucian Alliance, Dannic abandons them on a nearby planet. Meanwhile on the ship, Dr. Rush, Brody, Chloe, and Eli attempt a risky plan to force the Lucians to surrender.

With the need for food and water becoming dire, Dr. Rush manages to find a planet within range that seems viable but can only be accessed by shuttle. When nearing the planet, they encounter violent turbulence and must make a dangerous crash landing.

The Destiny is on a collision course with an ancient ship found floating in space. Panic turns to wonder as the ships dock with each other. The crew discovers that it might hold the key to a connection back to Earth and other hidden secrets.

On Destiny, Chloe's behavior has become a cause of concern and a worried Scott makes a shocking discovery while searching her quarters: a journal with Alien script. He shows it to Young and Rush who decide they must keep a constant eye on Chloe.

SG-1 lands in the middle of a blazing battle between some Stargate soldiers and a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, O'Neill and the others provide assistance… until the mystery team turns its weapons on SG-1!

During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.

SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia. The planet's leader, a woman named Ke'ra, returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure. But as Ke'ra and Daniel develop a mutual attraction, SG-1 suspects she may not be who she appears to be.

Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. No one but Jolinar has ever escaped from hell, so Tok'ra technology is used to access Jolinar's memories from Carter's mind…but not before an old foe shows up to foil the mission!

During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories…but how much can they take?

During routine medical exams, Dr. Fraiser injects each team member with a sedative. Teal'c awakens and sees General Hammond conspiring with Fraiser and two aliens. What has happened at Stargate Command, and can SG-1 overpower its own allies?

Friends from all over the world descend on Strawberryland to take part in the first Great Friendship Festival.

programmes.d: Out gathering berries one day, Strawberry & her pets find a tiny fairy among the berry vines.
One windy day, a tiny fairy named Sherry Bobbleberry gets blown into Strawberry’s open window.
Apple Dumplin’ wants to help Strawberry & her Friends with the baking.  But Dumplin’s just a little too little to be much help.  In fact, she ends up making a pretty big mess of things.
At the urging of Honey Pie Pony, Strawberry & Friends decide to put on a Cooking Show.
It’s that time of year when the berries are about to burst into bloom – and it looks like this will be a bumper crop!
Strawberry has her hands full when she agrees to babysit a young Berrykin who has magical powers.
Lemon orders a new high-tech machine to do salon services faster, then worries that she is no longer needed in the community.
A packaging mix-up at the seed company results in Blueberry planting popcorn instead of daisies.

programmes.d: Strawberry fills in at the bumblebee post office and learns that sometimes even when you try your very best, things don't always turn out as planned.
Strawberry struggles with how to be the berry best hostess when she has the very worst house guests.

When the rainbow friends try to make a movie starring Princess Kiki, they discover they need Rainbow Ruby to pull everything together and make it happen. // Rainbow Ruby realizes trying to get 3 tots back to sleep can be both frustrating and fun.

Strawberry and her friends love to dance – and the Peculiar Purple Pieman of Porcupine Peak is taking advantage of that!
It’s winter and the pond’s frozen and that means Strawberry and friends can ice skate!

Strawberry and her friends are getting the band back together to perform at a local festival, but Ginger Snap is out of town.
Strawberry Shortcake has always dreamed of seeing a certain rare flower, which only blooms once every ten years – and then only for a day!
After an accidental wager with Purple Pieman, Strawberry sets off to prove that she can go around the world in 80 days.
Strawberry and her friends try to break a Berry Bitty World record to win a vacation for Berrykin Bloom.

Plum disregards Strawberry’s rule to sign up for use of the café, and is forced to reschedule a big dance recital. She holds a grudge and starts instigating wacky, nonsensical rules to prove rules are silly.
Berry Bitty City holds an election to see who will fill in as 'BerryFest Princess' while Princess Berrykin is absent.

When Strawberry finds herself in charge of the upcoming BerryFest parade, she hopes her gal pals can help her with the overwhelming amounts of chores. But each of them is rather demanding and ungracious, so they're no use at all.

The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programmes.st: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programmes.d: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business.  The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby.  They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Goes To School
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read.  When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez.  Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing.  Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid.  The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract.  The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.
An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.
When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, bookkeeper Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman to take care of the problem.
A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.
Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.
When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.
When renegade Apaches wound Lucas and kidnap Mark, Marshall Torrance joins with U.S. Marshall Sam Buckhart to form a rescue posse.
Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas. Lucas must clear his name.
When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.
When a wealthy rancher is killed, Mark suggests that they seek the aid of a mind reader to identify the murderer.
A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.
After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.
Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.
After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.
Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.
Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.
Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.
Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.
While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.
Lucas makes a life-or-death decision when Micah is held hostage and the kidnappers demand the release of a notorious outlaw.
Lucas tries to do a good deed for the old town drunk but it backfires when the drunk's son believes he inherited Lucas' ranch.
A dance hall singer asks Lucas to care for her daughter in an effort to hide the baby from her self-righteous, bigoted father.
Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.
Mark runs away from home after his father questions his story about overhearing a plot to rob the bank.
A famous buffalo hunter tries to goad Lucas into a shooting match. When Lucas refuses, he becomes the new target.
When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.
Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.
Lucas is drawn to a young widow passing through town on her way to claim an inheritance but others who covet it are trying to kill her.
After a young stablehand kills a notorious gunslinger, he is baffled by the hostility of the townspeople about giving him the reward.
When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer. The plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A condemned killer being transported by train murders a marshal and takes Mark hostage.
When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.
A man considers several possibilities when offered one wish by a genie.
Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.
Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.
A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.
A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.
Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.
The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.
A lonely man falls in love with a mini museum doll, which he believes is alive.

programmes.st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programmes.d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

programmes.st: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.
A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.
A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own.
Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.
A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.
An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.
A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programmes.st: The Old Man in the Cave
programmes.d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."
A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programmes.st: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programmes.d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.
On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.
Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.
A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Big Blackmail
programmes.d: A double-dealing foreign diplomat attempts to implicate the United States in an international conspiracy.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Doomsday Formula
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon are determined to foil an ex-army general's plan to gain possession of a secret explosive formula.
A man uses a steam-driven juggernaut to drive off homesteaders so he can appropriate their oil-rich land.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Sedgewick Curse
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon come across a physician plying a wealthy family with a drug that causes rapid aging.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Gruesome Games
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon, searching for a powerful germ culture, invade the mansion of an eccentric millionaire.
A strange sea monster preying on Portuguese fishermen and their boats becomes the object of an investigation by agents West and Gordon.
West and Gordon must escape a Western town whose entire population is hunting them to free the prisoner they have taken.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Egyptian Queen
programmes.d: Secret Service agent James West seeks to find a missing ruby for an Egyptian Princess.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Fire And Brimstone
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon determine to foil the recovery of a fortune that was originally destined to help the Confederate cause.
A meek secret agent, whom West and Pike first feel will be a detriment, proves to be invaluable as they deal with an opium ring.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Avaricious Actuary
programmes.d: A sinister scientist who employs a monstrous tuning fork as an instrument of extortion becomes James West's antagonist.
West meets up again with his old enemy, Dr. Miguelito Loveless, who is engaged in a whimsical plan for wholesale murder.
Secret Agent West challenges a bizarre scheme to control San Francisco Bay Shipping with rockets fired from Alcatraz Island.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Spanish Curse
programmes.d: People living in New Mexico border towns are being terrified by a mysterious outlaw gang known as "Cortez and his Conquistadores."

programmes.st: The Night Of The Winged Terror (Part 1)
programmes.d: Agent West vows to destroy Raven, an organization that induces influential citizens to commit sabotage through mind conditioning.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Winged Terror (Part 2)
programmes.d: Agent West's bizarre behavior convinces his cohorts that he has become another victim of the Raven's mind-conditioning plot.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Sabatini Death
programmes.d: A dying man's request to preserve a legacy for his young ward sends James T. West to Missouri, where he faces a wholesale conspiracy.
Mulder deciphers psychic photos revealing his darkest fantasies and fears.
Mulder meets a woman in a cult whom he may have known in a previous life.
A plastic surgeon may be extending his own life through black magic.

programmes.st: Musings of a Cigarette Smoking Man
programmes.d: The agents learn the truth behind the assassination of JFK and Area 51.
A deadly, viscous organism is discovered inside a strange rock.
Mulder gains proof the organism inside the rock is an alien entity.
Prophetic dreams send Mulder on a search for a serial killer’s victims.
Mulder and Scully track the mythical creature known as El Chupacabra
A decapitated medic may be an evolutionary freak capable of regeneration.
Scully begins dating a man whose jealous tattoo compels him to murder.
Mulder breaks into a lab to find the cure that could save Scully’s life.
The agents uncover a murder that may have been committed by a dead man.
A seemingly invisible Vietnam vet begins killing the military’s top brass.
The agents investigate the unexplained crash of a commercial airliner.
Passengers aboard a plane are sacrificed in pursuit of alien technology.
Scientists found frozen to death may have been killed by a time traveler.
The father of babies born with vestigial tails is a chameleon-like man.
Chrissy falls for an older man she meets at the supermarket. Jack is jealous, but he's even more upset when Mr. Roper tells Jack and Janet that she knows the man's wife. Guest Star(s): Dick Sargeant
When Janet develops a sudden interest in having a baby, Jack and Chrissy hold some hilarious interviews with the men who they think have answered her advertisement for a father-for-hire.
Jack, Janet, and Chrissy plot to escape a boring Christmas party alone with the Ropers because the three roommates are invited to a big bash the same night.
Chrissy and Janet have to solve a gourmet mystery to help Jack graduate from cooking school.

Jack, Janet, and Chrissy's landlord, Stanley Roper, sells the apartment building but resists his wife Helen's desire to move into a new townhouse in a "swinging" development next door to a snobbish realtor who thinks they will lower the community's tone.
Chrissy finds out that Jack has become a male escort and is running around with an older woman.
Jack has two dates, so he talks Larry into posing as him and spending the day with his unwanted date, Janet's childhood friend, who is visiting from out of town.
Jack has to do a lot of double-talking on his first night as a busboy at a posh French restaurant when the gang comes to dinner expecting him to be the head chef. Guest Star(s): Michael Lombard
When Terri breaks up with her ill-tempered boyfriend, he believes that Jack is the cause. Guest Star(s): Jeffrey Tambor

A customer of the flower shop names Janet in his will, and she receives a vase. His nephew, Philip, an art collector, visits Janet, and Jack thinks he lied about the value of the vase and is trying to get it back.
Jack poses as his own twin to romance Ralph Furley's attractive visiting niece.
Larry's sly suggestion that he and Jack trade apartments after Jack has a tiff with the girls gives lustful Larry the chance to really put the move on Janet and Cindy.

Jack's father visits unexpectedly and resumes his good nature meddling. Jack explodes and tells him to stay out of his life, but when he learns his father has lost his job, Jack gives him the opportunity to be useful.
Overprotective Janet goes into a rage when she finds Jack in the same bed with her attractive sister - who is visiting.
Jack must come up with a "wife" to persuade his boss's man-hungry daughter that he's not available.

Cheryl asks Jack to father her child, but Jack refuses. Janet thinks Cheryl wants to marry Jack because she's going to have his baby, so she talks Jack into complying with Cheryl's wishes. Guest Star(s): Joanna Kerns
The trio reluctantly take on former roommate Cindy as their cleaning woman.
A former cook in the Navy with Jack comes to town to con his way into a partnership in Jack's Bistro.
When Jack's never-ending schemes to endear himself to a beautiful woman totally backfire, he decides to forego his little white lies for honesty.
All work no play makes Jack an angry boy when Janet hires him to work for her and acts like a tough boss.
Jack's fast-talking friend, Larry, gives Jack and the girls a puppy and the kids go to all lengths keeping this from Roper who forbids animals in his building.
Jack concocts a plan to regain the favor of an attractive Southern Belle he insulted on a date. Guest Star(s): Gwen Humble

Janet's date, a newspaper writer, offers to do a column on the trio's methods of coping with inflation. The published article, however, insinuates that their living arrangement is more intimate than practical.
Jack believes Chrissy's friend is the perfect sweetie to bring home to mom, until Janet discovers she's a high-priced call girl headed for a wild convention.

Jack believes he has won a baking contest that is open only to women. Disguised as "Grandma Tripper," he goes to collect the check and learns that he is a finalist and must bake his cookies for the company's executives to win the prize.
Jack gets caught in an exasperating willpower contest with Chrissy to determine whether he can give up women for longer than she can give up food.

Terri is up for a promotion and tells Dr. Kenderson she is married to ward off his advances. When he invites himself and his wife over for dinner, Jack poses as Terri's husband while Janet and Larry pose as French-speaking house guests.
It's no more "Mr. Nice Guy" after Jack learns how to get his way with Chrissy and Janet.
Jack is grateful for Larry's suggestion of a free guitarist as a business boost - until he finds out that he has a vocalist - Larry.
Panic reigns in the apartment when Mr. Roper takes the rent money without leaving the girls and Jack a receipt, making them think their place was robbed.
Only Jack knows the truth when Chrissy, Janet, and Mrs. Roper think that Stanley is fooling around with another woman.
Jack Tripper, a chef for all seasons, turns out to be quite a dish himself when he disguises himself as roommate Chrissy to skirt FBI agents on his trail.

An unexpected visit from Chrissy's father, the minister, throws the kids into a panic. Jack decides to move out temporarily but Reverend Snow arrives before Jack can leave. Fumbling for an explanation, Janet blurts out that she and Jack are married.

On December 6th, 1996 Montell Griffin and James Toney fought for a second time at the Lawlor Events Center in Reno for World Light Heavyweight titles resulting in an unanimous decision win for Griffin.

On November 14th, 1966 Muhammad Ali faced Cleveland Williams at the Astrodome in Houston, TX. They fought for WBC World Heavyweight titles in what was supposed to be a 15 round bout only went 3 resulting in a win for Ali.

On February 6th, 1967 Muhammad Ali fought Ernie Terrel at the Astrodome in Hourston, Tx. They fought for WBA and WBC World Heavyweight titles in a bout that went 15 rounds ending in a unanimous decision victory for Ali.

On September 20th, 1972 Muhammad Ali faced Floyd Patterson for a second time at Madison Square Garden in New York that ended in the seventh round due to swelling and cuts on Pattersons eye giving the victory to Ali.

On October 1st, 1975, Muhammad Ali and Joe Frazier fought for the third time for the World Heavyweight Title. Known as the "Thrilla in Manila," Ali ultimately emerged as the victor in what is considered one of the greatest boxing matches of all time.
On April 1st, 1972 Muhammad Ali and Mac Foster fought in a fifteen round bout that ended in a unanimous decision win for Ali.

programmes.t: Muhammad Ali vs Oscar Natalio Bonavena
programmes.d: On December 7th, 1970 Muhammad Ali faced Oscar Natalio Bonavena in a 15 round bout with Bonavena going down three times in the last round forcing an automatic stoggage giving the win to Ali.

On January 28th, 1974 Muhammad Ali and Joe Frazier face eachother for a second time at Madison Square Garden in New York for North American Boxing Federation Heavyweight titles resulting in a strong win for Ali.

On September 10th, 1973 Muhammad Ali and Ken Norton participated in their second meeting at the Forum in Inglewood, CA. They fought for the North American Boxing Federation Heavyweight title with Ali winning this time with split decision.
On October 31st, 2020 Naoya Inoue faced Jason Moloney in The Bubble at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas for the IBF and WBA World Super Bantamweight titles ending in a knockout in the 7th round by Inoue.

programmes.t: Naoya Inoue vs Nonito Donaire II
programmes.d: On June 7th, 2022 Naoya Inoue battled Nonoito Donaire for a second time at the Super Arena in Saitama for IBF, WBA and WBC World Bantamweight title with Inoue ending the bout in the second round defeating Donaire.

On December 15th, 2012 Nonito Donaire faced Jorge Arce at the Toyota Center in Houston, Tx. With the bout ending in the third round with a win by Donaire, Arce announced his retirement in the ring after the bout.

programmes.t: Orlando Salido vs Juan Manuel Lopez 2
programmes.d: On March 10th, 2012, Orlando Salido fought Juan Manuel Lopez for the WBO World Featherweight Title in San Juan, Puerto Rico. In a very entertaining fight with both fighters scoring knockdowns, Salido stopped Lopez in the 10th round.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Curtis Strong
programmes.d: On February 6th, 1993 Oscar De La Hoya and Curtis Strong fought at the Sports Arena in San Diego, Ca. in a 6 round bout that lasted 4 rounds ending in a technical knockout victory for De La Hoya.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Felix Sturm
programmes.d: On June 5th, 2004 Oscar De La Hoya fought Felix Sturm at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas for the WBO Middleweight title in a 12 round bout resulting in an unanimous decision win for De La Hoya.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Fernado Vargas
programmes.d: On September 14th, 2002, Oscar De La Hoya and Fernando Vargas fought for Super Welterweight titles at the Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas. In an incredible battle, De La Hoya was able to stop Vargas in the 11th round.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Giorgio Campanella
programmes.d: On May 27th, 1994 Oscar De La hoya fought Giorgio Campanella at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas for the WBO World Super Featherweight title with De La Hoya knocking out Campanella in the thrid round securing his victory.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Hector Camacho
programmes.d: On September 13th, 1997 Oscar De La Hoya fought Hector Camacho for the WBC World Welterweight title at the Thomas and Mack Center in Las Vegas the twelve round bout ended in a unanimous decision victory for De La Hoya.

programmes.t: Oscar De La Hoya vs Jeff Mayweather
programmes.d: On March 13th, 1993 Oscar De La Hoya and Jeff Mayweather faced eachother at the Hilton Hotel in Las Vegas in an 8 round bout then ended by technical knockout in the fourth round securing the victory for De la Hoya.

Forget the monsters under your bed; the real ones, from dinosaurs to mythic beasts, are out there just waiting to be unearthed.

From a legendary city swallowed by the jungle, to an underground metropolis stretching 18 levels deep, and even a forgotten pyramid from a lost civilization, sometimes the biggest mysteries on Earth are closer than we think.

From a Fabergé egg found at a humble flea market, to rare baseball cards hidden inside an old piano or even a backyard sapphire worth a king's ransom; these treasures prove that one person's forgotten clutter can become another's discovery.

A forgotten manuscript in a dusty trunk; a priceless painting discovered in plain sight; a royal tomb hidden for millennia beneath the sands; these famous finds prove history's greatest treasures often resurface when least expected.
Some secrets refuse to stay buried; whether it's illicit cargo in a frozen lake, a stolen masterpiece worth millions, or a brothel hidden in the shadow of the Capitol-the truth always resurfaces.

A long-lost keepsake tied to the world's most famous astronaut, a giant flying reptile that once ruled the skies, and a previously unknown planet orbiting two suns; some extraordinary discoveries remind us to keep looking up.

Owing a favor to a sheriff, Josh agrees against better judgment to go to the lawless town of Bent Horn to bring back a man wanted for bank robbery and murder.
A banker with a consuming thirst for vengeance hires Randall to accompany him to track down the man he believes responsible for his son's death and a bank robbery.
Josh plays detective when he signs on to help an amnesiac discover his identity.
A concerned father hires Josh to retrieve his son, a passionate young ideologue whose gift for rousing rhetoric is being used by plunderers to recruit freedom fighters.
A reclusive old man with an Apache bodyguard is wanted for a crime committed long ago.
On the trail of a Cavalry deserter and the horses he stole, Josh rides into a town ruled as the private fiefdom of its autocratic, psychopathic marshal who is holding the horses and deserter.

Gallant Bat Masterson turns Cupid's little mailman. When the man escorting three mail-order brides to Noble Creek, is shot, Bat becomes his replacement. For some unknown reason, a certain 'hot gun' doesn't want the gals to arrive.
Sheriff-maker Bat Masterson has his work cut out for him after brothers Jeb, Gus and Jocko Dakota gun down the lawman in their town. Their purpose: they want a free hand in operating their rackets.

Bat turns banker in Denver and discovers that having gold isn't enough - you've got to be able to convince other people you've got it. When one of Bat's enemies starts a run on the bank, Bat brings home the bullion.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.

Bat Masterson's friend 'Cactus Charlie' Hayden strikes gold.  When he repays Bat for staking him it's revealed that the gold is part of a missing shipment.  Bat and Hayden set out to make the best of a bad situation - and do so.
Ike Brennan hires Paladin to escort him through Indian country in order to exchange goods for his wife who is being held hostage by the Indians.
After encountering a woman burying her fiancee in an unmarked grave, Paladin is persuaded to go after the deceased's killer.
The promoter of a wild west show asks Paladin for help taming down a very wild and famous sharpshooter.
Paladin trails a killer and bank robber to a saloon but while trying to capture him, the saloon's owner, Big Red, is shot.
Paladin finds a sick old man and his son trying to protect their mine from claim jumpers.
New Mexico rancher Jesse Reade hires Paladin for $1,000 to bring back outlaw Dave Enderly, who has run off to Perdido, Mexico with Reade's daughter Nancy.

Young and beautiful Liz Dolthan stands by as Hollister opens a safe to deposit personal valuables belonging to the stagecoach passengers. When the safe is robbed, Hollister devises a ruse to make Liz reveal the fact that she has an amazing memory.

Convicted of murder, Vince Harper breaks jail and seeks refuge with an old friend: Editor Claibourne. Believing in Harper's innocence, the editor agrees to hide him until he can uncover new evidence, leading Sheriff Hollister to strike a deal.

After killing a man in self-defense in the town of Galeno, Sheriff Hollister (Pat Conway) finds himself hauled before a kangaroo court for trial on a murder charge, the penalty of which is death. An unexpected ally comes to Hollister's defense.

Rancher Bert Magraw returns from Denver with his young bride Jeannie. The same day, notorious gunslinger Vince Sanders arrives in town and baits Magraw into a gunfight. Sheriff Hollister steps in to save Magraw's life and uncover a conspiracy.

Sheriff Hollister (Pat Conway) arrests pretty Anita Torreon as a receiver of loot for a holdup gang and takes her to Prescott to stand trial. But, aboard the stagecoach, disguised gunmen suddenly appear to rescue Anita and recover the loot.

An enraged Apache bravely kills the white man who murdered his father. Both Sheriff Hollister and the victim's brother pursue the Indian -- with very different goals -- and trap him in a box canyon that the Apache has rigged with dynamite.
Allison Windrom hires Paladin to stop her father and Graham Beckley from dueling.

Meet the 10 brave participants returning for a chance at redemption on ALONE Season 5 and get an inside look at the extreme new location of Northern Mongolia.

Ten new participants brave Alone's most terrifying location yet in pursuit of $500,000. One participant is forced to make a life-or-death decision, and all must contend with Chilko Lake's deadliest predator: the grizzly bear.

More participants begin their fight against the land's harsh conditions and its abundant grizzly population. One survivalist builds a unique shelter, while others test their might against the treacherous waters of Chilko Lake.

The participants test new strategies to procure food as the predators pose an increasing threat. One participant fears they consumed a poisonous plant, while an intruder sabotages another's only chance at hunting.

The mental toll of isolation begins pushing participants' psychological boundaries to their limits. One survivalist gets caught in an off-putting standoff, while the increasing emotional cost of solitude afflicts another.

Four bladesmiths are given a special assignment when they are tasked with forging Doug Marcaida's favorite blade: the Karambit. The competitors are in for twice the challenge when they must create a matching pair of the lethal knives.

Four bladesmiths must scavenge a construction site to salvage their own knife-making materials. The smiths are then presented with an additional physical challenge when they are required to use a hand-cranked coal forge for the first round.

The odds are stacked against four bladesmiths when they must each forge a chopper in a distinct Damascus pattern. The ladder to success is full of twists as they struggle to achieve the specific look of each pattern.
Four bladesmiths must start at the bottom when they are tasked with creating ladder pattern damascus knives from a real ladder.
A quartet of bladesmiths are tasked with making canister damascus using barbershop tools, but before the knife making can begin, they must harvest their cans from an old barber's chair.

It's anchors aweigh, as four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a Pirate's Boarding Axe from a treasure chest. They must batten down the hatches as they battle wayward welds and forging fiascos that leave two smiths high and dry.
In this special kung fu competition, four bladesmiths square off in the Forged in Fire dojo where they must make a matching set of three kunai throwing knives.
With just three days left in the season, a team sets off to find a serial killer gator named "The Reaper" that has been snatching cattle from ranches in the middle of the night.
With only 48 hours left in gator season, and weather threatening, the race is on to tag out. One swamper invents a stout secret weapon, while other teams split up to cover more ground.

On last day of alligator season, a massive cold front hits the bayou--driving swampers to extreme measures in order to tag out. One hunter is forced to make the risky move of crashing his boat through a beaver dam.
With the first day of gator season under way, swampers are under attack from some of the biggest and meanest gators in years.

Tori is selected to be the team captain for a new game show, Brain Squeezers. She has to choose 3 teammates to compete with her and quickly becomes overwhelmed by requests from the gang.
When Tori gets invited to sing the national anthem at a televised basketball game, she worries she'll forget the lyrics, but ends up in a much more embarrassing encounter with the team's mascot.

Andre gets Tori a job at a frozen yogurt stand, but work may keep them from performing at the Hollywood Arts Cowboy Luau.  Robbie wants to ask Cat to the luau, but asks someone else, making Cat jealous.
Tori and the gang compete to see who can get the most followers on The Slap.  But when they get caught up in the competition, they neglect their schoolwork and their friendships.
Tori wins a contest to sing the opening number at a big music awards show, but the producer wants to totally change her look and behavior. Tori agrees, but finds that she doesn't like her new image.

After Tori fills in for her ailing sister in a big musical showcase, Tori is asked to enroll at an elite performing arts high school.  But once there, Tori struggles to fit in to her new surroundings.
Tori goes all out to master an iconic Hollywood Arts monologue in Sikowitz's class.  Meanwhile, André and Robbie join a ballet class to meet girls, with disastrous results.
Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise.  Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.
Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back.  Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.
Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.
After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back.  Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!
Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present.  An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop.  Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

programmes.d: When a hot young filmmaker comes to Hollywood Arts, the kids are excited to work on his project.  But when the film is released, and they aren't given credit, the kids turn to revenge.
As the kids prepare for a big play, Rex is accidentally sucked into a giant fan and Tori is responsible.  Robbie is an emotional wreck, and it's up to Tori to save the day by saving Rex's life.
Sikowitz recruits the gang to form a children's band for a friend's party.  When a leaked video of the group's performance becomes popular, Andre struggles to be taken seriously as a musician.

Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.
Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.
The kids are excited to hear that they'll be the stars of a new reality show being filmed at Hollywood Arts. Meanwhile, Trina and Robbie are forced to work at The Grub Truck after injuring Festus.
Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.

Carly, Sam, Freddie, and Spencer go to Japan for the “iWeb Awards”. Kyoko and Yuki, their competition, have their cousins trap Spencer and Mrs. Benson, while they leave Carly, Sam, and Freddie in the middle of nowhere.
Spencer tries to surprise Carly for her birthday and ends up burning down her bedroom instead. But when the insurance company hands him a big check, he has a chance to make it up to her.
After an iCarly fan proposes to his girlfriend live on the web show, the gang gets roped into going to the wedding.  But when the bride gets cold feet, Carly must come to the rescue.

1995-1997-A series of unsolved kidnappings and sexual assaults occur in California. A victim says that she left something behind in the assailants vehicle which may send investigators in the right direction.

The wife of a murdered horse rancher explains that the last time she saw her husband was when he was leaving the house to go jogging. Police become suspicious when forensic evidence eventually leads investigators back to the ranch.
In 2002, the eyes of the world were on Virginia and Maryland. A serial sniper was on the loose, killing innocent, unsuspecting citizens. Just how was he caught?

Sheila Bryan, who was convicted of killing her mother in a car fire, is granted a new trial. A fire expert witness's opinion on how the fire ignited differs from the prosecution's theory. If verified, it would clear Bryan of any culpability.
Computers aid the police and FBI in solving a string of crimes in St. Louis.

The story of firefighter Michelle Baker is related. After meeting Dr. Maynard Muntzing, she became pregnant with him. After this news, she was ill whenever they were together. The coincidences led her to suspect that he was doing her harm.

A look back at a trio of unsolved murders that occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas, during the 1980s details how a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with more than they realized.
Phone mapping, wiretapping and other forensic evidence help to solve a complicated crime.
An examination of the 2002 DC area shooting spree that resulted in ten murders.
A woman wins her release after being imprisoned for allegedly killing her mother in a car fire.
A phone number helps police to find an abductor.

Janet Overton died suspiciously in 1988, and the investigation hit a dead end when the autopsy indicated no foul play was involved. A telephone tip and the sensitive nose of a forensic examiner indicated otherwise.

In 1981, an 86-year-old California woman was murdered, and her house was ransacked. The crime would remain unsolved for sixteen years, until DNA profiling and new fingerprint technology helped identify the killer.

Forensic scientists work with the only clue recovered from a multiple-victim shooting: a 12-gauge shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner.
Detectives use a forged signature to find a woman's abductor.
In the case of the Center City Rapist and the murder of Shannon Schieber, Philadelphia authorities use an anonymous letter and geographic profiling to hone in on a suspect.
In 1993, worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies that targeted tourists in Florida.
Technology able to analyze human bite-marks yields information on a woman's death.

Authorities track a kidnapper who allowed his victim, 17-year-old Shari Smith, to write a last will on a notepad and then informed the family of her murder, as well as the later murder of a 10-year-old, Debra May Helmick.
A nurse learns that she has been deliberately infected with HIV.
A pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom.
A man died in his home after a long history of heart disease. It was assumed that this was the cause of his death. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surfaced that the death was no accident.

In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her home, and it changed the feeling of security residents had in the small town of Waseca, Minnesota. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.
In 1962, the people of the small town of Hanford, California, lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies that targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived despite severe injuries.
A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later. Witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a time-stamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.
At a murder scene, investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs, and unknown fingerprints. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. The similarities in the cases were striking, and examiners must determine if the suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors can discover the cause until she visits the gynecologist for a routine checkup. Then she learns it's something far worse than the flu.

Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.
Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed, and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker.

A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine the time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist, and a short-order cook answer their question.

A union official was executed in his home not long after a strike by the union members. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood heard any gunshots. It would take a forensic sound test, an electron microscope, and a nightgown to explain why.

A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to reexamine the motives of this so-called hero.
A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder and that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

When firefighters found an entire family dead inside their home, it looked like a murder-suicide, but there were several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card, and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

Two men were murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroyed a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips, and a chicken feather could link what appeared to be two separate crimes.

A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. The case stalls for more than a year, and then investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA data bank.

With no forensic evidence inside a murder scene, investigators were baffled. But they suspected that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If she had, forensic scientists would have had to find a way to find out what the dog had seen.
Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide, or murder.

A woman was found dead in a ravine, but crucial crime scene evidence had been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turned cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brought the killer to justice.

When an 11-year-old girl disappeared from a small town in a remote area of Alaska, investigators wondered if she'd been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. It turned out neither was true.

Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.
For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to the police and the New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people, one for each astrological sign.

A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep, and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months passed, then years, and the crime was never solved. Then Kathleen's family hired a private investigator, who discovered her diary.
A retired police officer is discovered in his bed, dead of a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife first says the motive was robbery; then she tells police he committed suicide.
The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist, and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

The investigation of the kidnapping of a prominent banker's wife led police on a wild goose chase. An unexpected discovery made by an entomologist led to a new suspect and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

After a street fight took the life of a national wrestling champion, police had to determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense. A jury decided it was murder and sentenced the accused to a minimum of twenty years in prison.

In the 1980s, the drug trade ravages Chicago's inner city neighborhoods and violent crime threatens to destroy entire communities. As drug profits grow, gangs rule the streets.  One of the most dangerous is the El Rukns. FBI Agents team up with state and local police to bring them down, but in the process, uncover a bizarre and frightening terrorist plot.

In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary.  The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy.  The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack.   Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports.  One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.  The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted,  hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link.  Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero.  He had a gun and was willing to shoot.  The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way.  The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

In 1987, Seven inmates break out of a high security prison in New Mexico. The escapees, all violent criminals, are a threat to anyone who crosses their path. State and local police and the FBI know they must capture these men before they rob, rape and kill…again.

In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns.  Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.  As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

In the winter of 2001, two well-loved and respected college professors are found murdered in their home.  Nothing about the case makes sense.  No items are missing from the home and the couple had no known enemies.  Local police and FBI agents form a task force to find a pair of homegrown killers and a motive for the brutal crime they committed.

In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorizes the town of East Point.  Two people are killed, and two are critically wounded.  At first the shootings seem targeted, then they seem random.  As the body count climbs, the killer taunts law enforcement with mysterious notes.  Agents believe the shooter will continue until he is deador behind bars.

In the early 90s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands began smuggling thousands of kilos of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America,  local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI  work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano.
